Amazon-10578210.title: AI Marketing Program Manager
Amazon-10578210.description:
Amazon Global Selling is on a mission to help businesses of all sizes start local and grow global. We help Asia local businesses directly reach new customers around the globe across Amazon's 19 overseas marketplaces. Today, more than 50% of Amazon's total sales come from third-party sellers, and our team plays a critical role in driving that growth.
The Rest of Asia (ROA) Central Marketing team drives seller launch and success across Taiwan, Korea, Vietnam, and Southeast Asia. We focus on two areas: activating small and medium-sized sellers at scale through communication programs, and bringing Amazon's central product marketing programs to ROA sellers in ways that fit each market. We leverage marketing capabilities and AI tools proven in China, and we work with each country team to decide what fits their sellers, rather than applying one approach everywhere.
We are looking for an AI Marketing Program Manager who is both a marketer and a builder. You will build AI-powered tools and workflows that help marketers across ROA work faster and engage sellers with more relevant content. You will lead how AI is introduced into our marketing programs, from identifying where it adds value to measuring the results. You will also serve as the marketing owner for a specific domains, judging which programs fit ROA sellers and partnering with the business teams that own that domain. Success means AI tools that country teams actually use, and measurable improvement in how ROA sellers launch and grow on Amazon.
Key job responsibilities
- Build and ship AI-powered tools and agentic workflows for ROA marketing, such as content generation, localization, and seller communication, taking them from prototype to production.
- Map the AI tools already built by central and country teams, identify where AI can improve ROA marketing programs, and decide whether to reuse, adapt, or build.
- Own go-to-market for AI tools across ROA: position each tool for its target users, launch it with country teams, provide playbooks and training, and measure usage and business impact through A/B tests or holdout groups.
- Serve as the marketing owner for domains: assess which central programs and content fit ROA sellers, provide localization guidance, and act as the main marketing contact for the domain's business partners.
- Analyze seller and market data to uncover growth opportunities in your domain, and turn findings into recommendations that country teams can act on.
- Partner with BI, product, and engineering teams on data access and tool integration, and escalate blockers early.
About the team
Our team is focused on building marketing programs that deliver meaningful results for customers and the business alike. We value collaboration, experimentation, and a willingness to learn from both successes and setbacks. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every voice contributes to our shared mission.
Amazon-10578210.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience performing statistical analysis of data using SQL, Excel and other tools
- 2+ years of professional non-internship marketing, growth marketing, or e-commerce operations experience
- Experience building AI-powered or automated tools or workflows (e.g., LLM APIs, Python, or low-code platforms) deployed for business use
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Chinese and English

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working with teams across APAC region
- Experience in cross-border e-commerce, marketplace seller, or SMB marketing
- Experience owning an AI-powered tool or agentic workflow end to end, from design through post-launch iteration, used across multiple teams or markets with measurable business impact

Amazon-10484204.description:

Amazon-10501756.title: Principal Product Manager - AI, Amazon Global Selling - PMO
Amazon-10501756.description:
Amazon Global Selling (AGS) has been helping individuals and businesses increase sales and reach new customers around the globe. Today, more than 50% of Amazon's total unit sales come from third-party selection. The Global Selling team in China is responsible for recruiting local businesses to sell on Amazon's 18 overseas stores, and supporting local sellers' success and growth on Amazon. Our vision is to be the first choice for all types of Chinese business to go globally.
The Global Selling Product & Program team in AGS collaborates with many of Amazon's global teams to support the high-growth Global Selling business, continuously identify new opportunities, and drive new initiatives through design, development, launch, and post-launch management. As AI becomes increasingly central to our seller experience strategy, we are building AI-powered products and tools to drive seller growth and success, and support internal teams' efficiency and productivity. We are looking for a talented Principal Product Manager to join the team and lead the development of AI products that transform how sellers operate and grow on Amazon. The ideal candidate should be strong at understanding internal and external customer needs, identifying pain points, analyzing working models, deriving patterns, and designing AI-driven solutions. He/she also needs to work across teams - including engineering, data science, UX, and business stakeholders - to launch products, manage product releases, engage user organizations, handle change management, establish stakeholder communication, and be responsible for the ultimate success of product launches against defined goals in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment.
Key job responsibilities
* Define and drive AI product strategy across the Global Selling Seller segments and lifecycle, leveraging GenAI and machine learning technologies to build innovative products/services that help seller growth and optimize AM workflows, and continuously drive product success post launch
* Translate complex AI/ML capabilities into intuitive product experiences, clearly defining product requirements that balance technical feasibility with user needs and business impact
* Collaborate with and earn trust from internal stakeholders and external partners, including data scientists and ML engineers, to design and align AI-powered system solutions
* Work with technology teams to develop AI products, evaluate AI/ML model performance, resolve issues, and manage development cycles with understanding of AI product development lifecycle
* Drive responsible AI practices, ensuring products meet quality, fairness, and safety standards while delivering business value
* Manage stakeholder and leadership communications including problem statement and analysis, AI solution review, business/impact review, budget/HC planning, stakeholder change management, etc.
* Define success metrics and KPIs for AI products, establishing frameworks to measure product performance, user adoption, and business impact post-launch
* Stay current with AI/ML trends and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to incorporate new capabilities into the product roadmap
Amazon-10501756.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred qualifications
- Experience owning technology products

Amazon-10501752.title: Sr Product Manager (Tech), AI, WW Global Selling - PMO
Amazon-10501752.description:
Amazon WW Global Selling is looking for a dynamic, highly motivated Sr AI Product Manager to join the central PMO team. This is an unique opportunity to build high impact AI products to continuously improve Sellers' experience, growth and profitability. The ideal candidate should be strong at understanding customer needs, identifying pain points, analyzing working models, deriving patterns, designing AI solutions, and managing roadmaps. He/she also needs to work across teams to launch AI products, manage product releases, engage user organizations, handle change management, establish stakeholder communication, and be responsible for the ultimate success of product launches against defined goals in a cross functional, fast-paced environment.
Key job responsibilities
1. Define AI product vision and strategy that drive global seller success
2. Own the end-to-end AI product lifecycle — from ideation through technical development and experimentation, to launch, adoption, and iterative improvement — ensuring alignment between business objectives, seller needs, and technological capabilities.
3. Develop and communicate product requirements,  earn trust from cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, applied science, design, business operations) and external partners through clear documentation and aligned decision-making.
3. Lead cross-functional and cross-regional collaboration with scientists, engineering, and data teams to build, evaluate, and ship AI-powered products; drive development velocity by managing trade-offs, unblocking technical dependencies, resolving issues, and maintaining rigorous experimentation standards (A/B testing, model performance benchmarks).
4. Drive measurable business impact post-launch through continuous monitoring, data-driven iteration, and feedback loops; leverage market analysis and competitive intelligence to inform product positioning and roadmap evolution.
5. Manage stakeholder and leadership communications across multiple geographies — including problem framing, AI solution trade-off analysis, product/business reviews and etc. Partner with international stakeholders, leaders, and tech teams to align priorities and drive execution across regions.
About the team
We are WW Global Selling PMO team. We collaborate with WWGS business teams to identify key Seller needs and partner with global product teams to develop tools and solutions to improve Seller experience and sustainable growth.

Amazon-10572912.title: Data Engineer - AI/ML Products, AOP (Analytics Operations and Programs)
Amazon-10572912.description:
The AOP (Analytics Operations and Programs) team is responsible for creating core analytics, insight generation and science capabilities for ROW Ops. We develop scalable analytics applications, AI/ML products and research models to optimize operation processes. You will work with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Applied Scientists and Business Intelligence Engineers using rigorous quantitative approaches to ensure high quality data/science products for our customers around the world. As a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting the team by creating and maintaining the data infrastructure necessary for the advanced analytics and machine learning solutions.
Our team solves a broad range of problems that can be scaled across ROW (Rest of the World including countries like India, Australia, Singapore, MENA and LATAM). Here is a glimpse of the problems that this team deals with on a regular basis:
• Using live package and truck signals to adjust truck capacities in real-time
• HOTW models for Last Mile Channel Allocation
• Using LLMs to automate analytical processes and insight generation
• Ops research to optimize middle mile truck routes
• Working with global partner science teams to affect Reinforcement Learning based pricing models and estimating Shipments Per Route for $MM savings
• Deep Learning models to synthesize attributes of addresses
• Abuse detection models to reduce network losses
Key job responsibilities
1. Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines to support AI/ML model development and production deployment.
2. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for the data and AI/ML solutions.
3. Collaborate with data scientists and other team members to understand data requirements and implement efficient data processing solutions.
4. Create and manage data warehouses and data lakes, ensuring proper data governance and security measures are in place.
5. Collaborate with product managers and business stakeholders to understand data needs and translate them into technical requirements.
6. Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering, and propose innovative solutions to improve data infrastructure and processes for AI/ML models and analytics applications.
7. Participate in code reviews and contribute to the development of best practices for data engineering within the team.
About the team
The AOP (Analytics Operations and Programs) team is responsible for creating core analytics, insight generation and science capabilities for ROW Ops. We develop scalable analytics applications, AI/ML products and research models to optimize operation processes. You will work with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Applied Scientists and Business Intelligence Engineers using rigorous quantitative approaches to ensure high quality data/science products for our customers around the world.

- Knowledge of cloud services such as AWS or equivalent
- Experience with version control systems and CI/CD pipeline implementation

Amazon-10528110.title: Data Scientist, AI Program, CNGS NBS (New Business & New Seller) Amazon Business
Amazon-10528110.description:
Team & Project Overview
The NBS Data Central team powers analytics, data science, and AI capabilities for Worldwide Global Selling (WWGS). We build scalable data products, and insight-generation systems that drive seller growth across 10+ marketplaces.
Seller Intelligence is a P0 foundation theme at the Global Selling level, formed by merging "One Tagging" and "Good Contact" workstreams. It provides seller identity, segmentation, and contact-reach infrastructure that underpins all downstream seller-facing AI workflows — including intelligent outreach, personalized recommendations, and automated engagement.
Scope of Impact
Own the science pillar for Seller Intelligence within a cross-functional POD (PM + DE + DS + SDE)
Directly impact seller engagement metrics across CN, IN, LATAM, and East-Asia expansion regions
Models and data products consumed by 5+ downstream teams (ESM, NSR, MKT, NBS AI Ops, ROC)
Influence $100M+ annual seller GMS through improved segmentation and contact optimization
Key job responsibilities
Design and deliver seller segmentation and propensity models at scale — incorporating GMS, category, growth trajectory, engagement signals, and lifecycle stage.
Build contact quality scoring and lifecycle management systems (coverage optimization, dormancy detection, reactivation modeling).
Define success metrics, experimentation frameworks (A/B, causal inference), and measurement methodology for seller engagement interventions.
Productionize ML models and data products — partner with engineering to deploy seller scores, contact quality indices, and recommendation signals.
Explore LLM/GenAI applications: automated insight generation from seller data, contact intent classification, and intelligent report synthesis.
Serve as the science representative in bi-weekly NBS theme reviews; present findings and proposals to theme Bar Raisers and leadership.
Collaborate with BIE team members to democratize analytical outputs via dashboards and self-serve tools.
Contribute to cross-marketplace seller behavior analysis supporting Global Expansion strategy (IN, KR, VN, LATAM).
Evaluate, integrate, and iterate on AI systems — assess new AI/ML tools, frameworks, and third-party models for applicability to seller intelligence use cases.

- Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science
- Proven track record of end-to-end ML model delivery: problem formulation → feature engineering → training → deployment → monitoring
- Experience designing and analyzing A/B experiments at scale with rigorous statistical methodology
- Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped science deliverables
- Strong written and verbal communication — ability to present complex findings to non-technical stakeholders
- Experience working with or evaluating AI systems

Preferred qualifications
- Ph.D. in a quantitative field (Statistics, Machine Learning, Economics, Operations Research)

- Experience in seller/customer segmentation, propensity modeling, or CRM/lifecycle analytics
- Proficiency with distributed computing frameworks (Spark, EMR, Redshift, Hive)
- Experience working in a marketplace or platform business (e-commerce, SaaS, fintech)
- Familiarity with causal inference methods (DID, RDD, synthetic control, instrumental variables)

Amazon-10567071.title: API Support Engineer , Developer Support Engineering
Amazon-10567071.description:
Amazon is investing heavily in building a world-class advertising business, and we are responsible for defining and delivering a collection of self-service performance advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products are strategically important to our Retail and Marketplace businesses, driving long-term growth. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily, and are breaking fresh ground to create world-class products. We are highly motivated, collaborative, and fun-loving, with an entrepreneurial spirit and a bias for action. With a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, we are growing at an unprecedented rate with a seemingly endless range of new opportunities. Our business is growing fast and is highly visible to senior leadership.
We're looking for a Developer Support Engineer to join our global Advertising API Support team. In this role, you'll be the technical expert for developers and advertising partners integrating with the Amazon Ads API — troubleshooting complex integration issues, debugging API behavior, and driving root-cause resolution. You'll also serve as a Technical Account Manager (TAM) for a portfolio of key partners, owning those relationships end-to-end and proactively guiding them toward successful, scalable integrations.
This is a hybrid role that blends technical depth with meaningful account ownership. It's ideal for someone who is a fast learner and enjoys solving hard technical problems while being the trusted technical partner that customers rely on.
Key job responsibilities
As a Developer Support Engineer, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
- Providing support directly to developers using the Amazon Advertising API
- Writing code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the developer community
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication during critical events
- Contributing to documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles
- Owning the technical relationship for a portfolio of key API partners, serving as their primary point of contact
- Proactively monitoring partner health, anticipating risks, and driving resolution before issues escalate
- Building trusted, long-term relationships and representing the voice of the customer internally
Amazon-10567071.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 3+ years of software development, or 3+ years of technical support experience
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience working with REST API based services
- Knowledge of one or more scripting languages (e.g., Python, Ruby, Perl)
- Experience with data analysis and SQL

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with web-based applications and HTTP
- Experience as a technical specialist in customer-facing roles
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
- Experience working with AWS Services

Amazon-10389285.title: Acoustic Software QA Engineer, Asia Tech Center
Amazon-10389285.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced groundbreaking devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?
The Role:
As a Acoustic Software QA Engineer, you will work with consumer application testing expertise. You will join the team of hands-on, pro-active, self-motivated and seasoned SQA professionals. In this role, you will:
- Create test plans and test cases
- Efficiently execute test cases across all functional areas of our products especially have expertise in Audio.
- Review product user interface for conformity to design guidelines
- Find, isolate, document, regress, and track bugs through resolution
- Interpret and report testing results, and be a vocal proponent for quality in every phase of the development process
- Work with Software Development Engineers to understand the overall technical architecture and how each feature is implemented
- Collaborate with US teams and domestic partners in acoustic lab setting up and management
Amazon-10389285.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience scripting or coding
- 4+ years of delivering test frameworks, test tools, leading the QA projects and initiatives experience
- Knowledge of QA methodology, automation, industry-standard tools and bug tracking tools
- Familiarity with acoustic performance measurement and equipment
- Familiarity with acoustic lab environment setup

Preferred qualifications
- Familiarity with ACQUA and other acoustic measurement equipments
- Experience testing audio or speech related features in SW or HW products
- Familiarity with speech recognition, acoustics, psycho-acoustics, signal processing and sound reproduction
- Solid understanding of QA tool development chains and environments
- Hands-on experience in testing Linux/Android-based devices
- Demonstrated expertise in black, white box and grey box testing methodologies, experience with standard QA and development tools, and the ability to operate within short release cycles
- Creativity and initiative to improve product coverage and effectiveness

1 填写简历申请时，请把必填和非必填项都填写完整。提交简历之后就无法修改了哦！
2 学校的英文全称请准确填写。中英文对应表，请点击链接查看 https://docs.qq.com/sheet/DVmdaa1BCV0RBbnlR?tab=BB08J2
3 简历不限中英文。
如果您正在攻读自然语言处理（NLP）、信息检索（IR）、机器学习、生成式人工智能或相关方向的硕士或博士学位，并希望将前沿科学研究转化为服务真实客户的产品，我们诚挚邀请您加入亚马逊 International Technology 搜索团队。
我们的目标是帮助亚马逊客户更准确地找到所需商品，并发现符合其需求和兴趣的新商品。您每天的工作都将直接影响全球数百万客户的购物体验。团队使用 TB 级商品、查询和客户行为数据，持续推进搜索、推荐、自然语言理解以及生成式 AI 技术的发展。
在这个岗位中，您将研究并应用 NLP、IR、深度学习、大语言模型（LLM）和基础模型等前沿技术，解决搜索理解、相关性排序、语义匹配、个性化和对话式购物等问题。您将有机会探索预训练、监督微调（SFT）、参数高效微调、检索增强生成（RAG）、提示优化和智能体（Agent）等技术，并针对业务场景建立可靠的离线与在线评估方法。
您将与应用科学家、软件工程师和产品经理密切合作，完成从问题定义、数据分析、算法设计和实验验证，到模型部署、在线测试和持续迭代的完整闭环。您需要根据客户价值和业务目标选择合适的技术方案，并在模型质量、可靠性、安全性、推理延迟和计算成本之间做出合理权衡。
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
· 针对 Amazon 搜索和购物体验中的实际问题，提出可验证的科学假设，设计并实现机器学习、NLP、IR 或 LLM 解决方案。
· 使用大规模商品、查询和客户行为数据训练、微调和评估模型，建立可重复的实验与评估流程。
· 探索基础模型在搜索、推荐和对话式购物中的应用，包括 RAG、模型微调、提示优化和 Agent 等方向。
· 设计覆盖相关性、事实性、鲁棒性、安全性、延迟和成本的评估指标，并通过离线实验、A/B 测试和客户反馈验证效果。
· 与工程和产品团队合作，将原型转化为可扩展、可维护的生产系统，并持续分析和改进线上表现。
· 跟踪学术界和工业界的最新进展，形成技术文档，并在适当情况下向内部或外部科学社区分享研究成果。
基本要求
· 正在攻读或已获得计算机科学、计算机工程、机器学习、人工智能、运筹学、统计学或相关领域的硕士或博士学位。
· 具备机器学习或深度学习的基础知识，以及实验设计、统计分析和模型评估经验。
· 具备使用代码和工具实现、训练和评估算法的经验。
· 至少熟练使用一种编程语言，例如 Python、Java 或 C++。
· 了解 NLP、IR、推荐系统或生成式 AI 中至少一个方向的基本方法。
优先条件
· 在 NLP、IR、机器学习、数据挖掘或生成式 AI 相关顶级会议或期刊发表过论文，或有高质量研究项目经历。
· 熟悉 Transformer、LLM 或基础模型，并具有预训练、监督微调（SFT）、参数高效微调、偏好优化或推理优化中的一种或多种实践经验。
· 具有 RAG、向量检索、Embedding、语义匹配、Agent 或工具调用系统的研究或开发经验。
· 熟悉 PyTorch、TensorFlow 等深度学习框架，以及 Hugging Face Transformers 等常用 LLM 工具链。
· 具有搜索引擎或推荐系统经验，尤其是在索引、召回、排序、查询理解、个性化或在线实验方面。
· 具有 LLM 评估经验，能够从相关性、事实性、幻觉、鲁棒性、安全性、延迟和成本等维度衡量系统质量。
· 具有大规模数据处理、分布式训练、模型压缩或高效推理经验。
· 具备良好的批判性思维和技术沟通能力，能够清楚地解释模型选择、实验结果及其局限性，并与跨职能团队合作解决开放性问题。

Amazon-10553228.title: Consultant, Analytics, Ads Insights
Amazon-10553228.description:
Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising, offering unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We offer advertisers premium brand placements on our owned and operated properties, including Prime Video ads, Twitch, and a rich slate of retail media solutions.
As an Insights and Measurement Consultant, you will work as an individual contributor to accelerate our advertising business growth in Canada. You will serve as a strategic advisor, implementing analytics solutions to drive business transformation. You will lead Ad measurement discussions, create actionable insights, and present clear recommendations to executive stakeholders.
Key job responsibilities
• Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, third-party research, and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights
• Own senior-level measurement and insights customer relationships, partnering across strategic learning objectives that influence business decision-making
• Collaborate cross-functionally to influence sales and marketing initiatives across multiple business functions and geographies
• Advocate for data-driven decision-making and guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions
About the team
The Analytics & Insights team is a key member of the Amazon Ads Sales organization. We provide analytics-driven Sales enablement support internally as well as insights-based consulting for advertisers. Our team deliver impactful insights incorporating knowledge of existing measurement and product capabilities. We innovate to stay ahead of industry trends and cater to diverse advertiser/agency needs. We enable scaling of insights through strategic partnerships with product and engineering team.

- Ability to write complex SQL queries from scratch, extract and manipulate data, and create new measures and metrics

- Solid understanding of Data Science and Marketing Science subjects such as regression, hypothesis testing and audience analysis
- Ability to work cross-functionally and excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills
- Comfortable presenting complex analysis in an easy to digest way to stakeholders and C-suite level advertisers
- Fluency in spoken and written English and Chinese

- Publication track record/writing experience (ex. published a paper in a technical journal or trade publication)

Amazon-10572950.title: Data Center Technical Support Engineering Operations Engineer, BJS - DCEO
Amazon-10572950.description:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Services team provides comprehensive technical support throughout the design, planning, delivery, and operation of Amazon Web Services infrastructure. We support data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure the customers of Amazon Web Services have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations technical support managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across Amazon and our operating partners to help Amazon Web Services deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for the customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Facility Engineer will be responsible for providing technical support to Data Center Engineering Operations within data centers including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of data center infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.
基础设施技术支持主要负责支持数据中心的基础设施运维，包括对设施/系统存在的风险进行管理，提出缓解措施和改造方案，以及日常的基础设施的维护，供应商的管理，数据的整理归档汇报等。
Key job responsibilities
· Provide technical support for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
· Provide technical support for performance benchmarks establishment, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
· Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
· Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
· Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
· Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.
· Support the COLO management of both routine maintenance and emergency services on a variety of essential systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
· Assist in the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
· Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
· Assist in recruiting efforts.
· Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues.
· This role might involve covering 24x7 shift rotation
岗位职责：
•	为承包商、分包商和供应商的现场管理提供技术支持，确保所有工作符合既定流程、程序和当地法律。
•	支持建立执行标准，对数据中心基础设施的运维和维护各个方面进行分析并撰写报告。
•	为数据中心的日常工作创建变更管理请求和事件管理工单。
•	与DCO经理（IT）和其他部门主管以及现场IDC服务运营商合作，协调完成项目，管理站点容量，优化站点安全性，可用性，可靠性，可持续性和效率。
•	撰写，创建与业务和设施运维的技术支持相关的文件。
•	负责支持机柜的安装和机柜供电，供冷。
•	支持COLO（Co-Location，现场提供IDC服务的运营商）的日常常规维护和数据中心基本系统的紧急服务，如：开关柜，柴油发电机，UPS系统，配电设备，冷机，冷塔，精密空调，楼宇监控系统等。
•	协助新数据中心/机房的设计，实施，调试和建设。
•	推动并实施项目，以提高现有设施的产能，效率，可持续性和可靠性。
•	协助招聘工作。
•	支持运维合作伙伴解决运维中遇到技术问题。
•	可能参与轮换倒班以支持24x7的工作需求。
About the team
About Amazon Web Services
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Web Services values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Web Services?
Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Amazon Web Services pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust Amazon Web Services’ robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Amazon Web Services values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Amazon-10431244.description:

Data Center Technical Support Engineering Operations Technician (EOT )is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
EOT’s are data center's front line responders for support electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities:
English (both written and spoken English) as standard language to fulfill responsibilities below
- Support maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assist root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal SLA
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Support take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Able to work a 12 hour shift  to support 24/7 operations (rotating 3 to 4 day work weeks)

Amazon-10515809.title: HW Safety Compliance Engineer
Amazon-10515809.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Echo. What will you help us create?
Key job responsibilities
Drive a standardized and harmonized approach to Safety Compliance across Amazon’s suite of products
Be a technical leader able to utilize deep knowledge and experience to support junior compliance engineers and design teams on safety compliance issues and failures
Determine the applicable regulations, standards, and safety requirements for new and existing products.

Amazon-10467043.description:
Amazon Private Brands Product Quality team is looking for a smart, hard-working and creative member for our Shenzhen office. The successful candidate will show excellent judgment and instincts in decision making and proactively and continually improve their level of knowledge about Amazon's business, its platform, and relevant technologies. This is an exciting and challenging position that provides quality support as a subject matter expert (SME) to ensure products meet global safety standards and customer expectations.
The position is responsible for Amazon's worldwide quality program for Hardline categories focusing on the quality area. By supporting quality improvement approaches while creating innovative solutions that move at internet speed. This position will have an opportunity to apply SME knowledge in new and exciting ways. We are looking for a talented expert in Quality & Product Development who has direct experience with product quality requirements, new product introduction, manufacturing operations, testing and quality strategies to support our rapidly growing and evolving business.

- Develop usability testing plan and validate the corrective actions effectiveness
- Drive the implementation and accuracy of Quality Metric Trend Detection and implement preventive measures in upstream product development activities
- Continuously refine test methods and protocols with 3rd party testing agencies
- Monitor performance of 3rd party testing agencies
- Provide full visibility to internal stakeholders
- Develop best-in-class processes and systems, and drive continual improvement
- Drive scalable business solutions on product development and quality monitoring processes
- Work proactively with all stakeholders worldwide for product development, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance

Amazon-10571876.title: Reliability Engineer
Amazon-10571876.description:
Amazon develops innovative consumer-centric product solutions. As a reliability engineer you will be part of an exciting team developing, testing, and delivering products. Your primary responsibility will be the development and implementation of methodologies/techniques to enhance product reliability. You will work closely internal cross-functional teams and outside partners to drive and execute product qualification. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.
The reliability engineer will be responsible for:
- Create reliability test plans including resource allocations, validation schedule assumptions, and validation items scope.
- Manage the local  supplier team on reliability resource planning, test execution, failure analysis, and track the issues from creation to closure.
- Implement specific validation items in reliability test plans with schedule. Flexible adjustment should be made based on issue occurring and debugging.
- Lead and drive on DFMEA, debugging, failure analysis, DOEs and fixing issues discovered during testing.
- Evaluate and develop reliability test methodologies to reduce test time and increase test coverage.
- Evaluate reliability risks, perform risk assessment and do escalations to management team.
- Travel extensively in Vietnam and Asia to support reliability activities.
- Travel to US for team collaboration or training.
Key job responsibilities
- As a Reliability Engineer (RE) for critical components, the primary responsibility will be the development and implementation of methodologies/techniques to enhance product reliability and manage reliability activities.
- The RE will lead reliability engineering and operations activities throughout the program's execution phase, accountable for managing new component programs from PR/FAQ through to sustaining, across the company's development.
- The RE will work closely with internal cross-functional teams and outside partners to drive and execute product qualification and failure analysis.
- The RE will drive the configuration management deliverables to ensure the timely release of all device components and assemblies to production.
- The RE will also assist Rel Test Engineer  in enhancing suppliers' local infrastructure and capability, including lab construction, testing and FA capability, and assist with cross functional team activities to ensure the right level of engagement from reliability.
- The RE needs to have strong logical capabilities to summarize failures, solid statistical knowledge to perform risk assessments, and good judgment to provide team recommendations during failure escalations.
- The RE needs to be capable of technical dive deep in   the engineering scopes such as display, optic, camera, PD, EE, SoC, etc.

Amazon-10586383.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented,and technically skilled engineer for our robot products. This role is primarily responsible for software flashing, functional self-testing, problem diagnosis, documentation, and rework of non-conforming units. Meanwhile, you’re also needed for our Shanghai office’s inventory and tools management.
What you’ll be doing
Robot Setup & Flashing: Perform flashing, burning, and installation of OS, firmware, and software on end-of-line devices in strict adherence to Work Instructions (WI).
Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Identify software failures, hardware alerts, and anomalies. Utilize log tools and serial terminal debug tools to perform root-cause analysis, log fault details, and submit problem reports.
Robot EoL Testing: Strictly execute EoL test procedures, inspect for mechanical/functional failures, upload data to the cloud, and compile test reports.
Rework & Collaboration: Execute rework on software-related defects (re-flashing, setting restorations, configuration tweaks) and collaborate with HW/SW engineering teams on complex diagnostics.

Amazon-10452303.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager – Device Packaging, Devices & Services Experience Design - Packaging
Amazon-10452303.description:
The Devices & Services Experience Design (DxD) team leads user experience and industrial design innovation across Amazon's device portfolio, including Echo, Fire TV, Fire Tablets, Alexa.com, and related mobile apps. Our team works at the intersection of design, product and engineering, creating meaningful hardware and software experiences that enhance customer lives. We believe in storytelling and thinking holistically to craft the "why" behind everything we ship.
The Senior Packaging Engineering Program Manager drives the strategic vision and execution of packaging UX and design excellence across our devices portfolio—spanning new product launches and sustaining programs. This role owns the end-to-end packaging plan, including schedule creation, structural design development and approval, testing, and coordination of validation builds, aligning inter-disciplinary teams to ensure packaging structure and artwork meet global launch dates. Additional responsibilities include Bill of Material (BOM) management, compliance oversight, and Print On Demand (POD) labeling design and production.
Beyond execution, this role serves as a strategic partner to senior leadership—driving closure on ambiguous, high-impact trade-offs and ensuring packaging strategy is integrated with broader product and business objectives. The ideal candidate invents and simplifies—relentlessly eliminating complexity, challenging legacy processes, and architecting scalable solutions that raise the bar globally. This role demands a bias for action paired with long-term strategic thinking: delivering today's launches while building the mechanisms that accelerate tomorrow's.
Working closely with global, cross-functional partners—including Packaging Engineering, Industrial Design, Marketing, Legal/Compliance, Operations, and Hardware Technical Program Managers—the Senior Packaging Engineering Program Manager influences at all levels from concept through production. Success requires earning trust with senior leaders, navigating organizational complexity, and driving alignment across competing priorities to deliver results at scale.
Key job responsibilities
Define and manage the end-to-end packaging development schedule, ensuring on-time delivery of milestones from concept through production readiness.
Drive packaging structure alignment across cross-functional teams, facilitating timely decisions and stakeholder consensus.
Define, implement, and ensure accurate application of compliance-related content across all packaging deliverables.
Lead Print On Demand (POD) labeling support and execution, ensuring quality and on-time delivery.
Develop and execute packaging strategies supporting global product launches and regional market expansion.
Identify and implement process improvements and scalable mechanisms that increase efficiency and mitigate risk across packaging deliverables.
Coordinate resources and engage stakeholders to maintain schedule integrity across concurrent programs.
Proactively identify risks to packaging timelines and drive resolution through clear escalation and communication.
A day in the life
As a Packaging Engineering Program Manager, you'll drive packaging development programs forward in lockstep with hardware launch timelines — removing obstacles across operations, legal/compliance, and engineering to keep deliverables on track. From aligning packaging structures and resolving compliance content gaps to executing POD labeling and advancing global launch strategies, you'll operate at the intersection of multiple disciplines in a fast-paced, design-focused environment. If you're energized by innovation, thrive on navigating cross-functional challenges, and want to shape how customers experience our products from the moment they open the box, this role is for you.

Amazon-10541185.title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect, Professional Services
Amazon-10541185.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, designing and implementing tailored cloud solutions. You'll be a key player in the pre-sales process, providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the customer's cloud journey.
In this role, you'll be responsible for creating and leading the solution design to address customer business outcomes (CBO). Operating as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and our Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), you’ll ensure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimize ProServe and/or our partners to maximize CBOs. As a PCA you are a trusted advisor to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions to address customer challenges. As a technical SME, you will share knowledge within the organization, through mentoring, training, creation of reusable artifacts and process improvements.
Your experience in designing technical solutions within the technology/consulting sector, will equip you with the ability to architect complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer, translating technical concepts into business value. Your success as a PCA will be linked to impacting the signing of SOWs, and the successful implementation of solutions which achieve CBOs while exceeding customer satisfaction (CSAT) expectations.
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
Designing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions to deliver customer business outcomes (CBOs)
Providing technical guidance and best practices during pre-sales and implementation phases
Collaborating with Account Managers and Shared Delivery Teams to ensure proposed solutions are realistic and achievable
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 7+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience

Amazon-10602955.title: Senior Product Quality Engineering Manager, Private Brands
Amazon-10602955.description:
Amazon Private Brands Product Quality team is looking for a smart, hard-working and creative member for our Shenzhen office. The successful candidate will show excellent judgment and instincts in decision making and proactively and continually improve their level of knowledge about Amazon's business, its platform, and relevant technologies. This is an exciting and challenging position that provides quality support as a subject matter expert (SME) to ensure products meet global safety standards and customer expectations.
The position is responsible for Amazon's worldwide quality program for Hardline categories focusing on the quality area. By supporting quality improvement approaches while creating innovative solutions that move at internet speed. This position will have an opportunity to apply SME knowledge in new and exciting ways. We are looking for a talented expert in Quality & Product Development who has direct experience with product quality requirements, new product introduction, manufacturing operations, testing and quality strategies to support our rapidly growing and evolving business.
Key job responsibilities
- Ensure products continuously comply with Amazon’s quality, performance, reliability, as well as relevant safety and regulatory requirements worldwide
- Implement and apply Amazon Private Brand quality systems throughout the product life cycle
- Facilitate Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) as a framework and decision logic to define the testing depth, resources, budget, and SLAs required to deliver the right product to our customers
- Plan and supervise product benchmark testing for establishing product specifications and claims
- Develop usability testing plan and validate the corrective actions effectiveness
- Drive the implementation and accuracy of Quality Metric Trend Detection and implement preventive measures in upstream product development activities
- Continuously refine test methods and protocols with 3rd party testing agencies
- Monitor performance of 3rd party testing agencies
- Provide full visibility to internal stakeholders
- Develop best-in-class processes and systems, and drive continual improvement
- Drive scalable business solutions on product development and quality monitoring processes
- Work proactively with all stakeholders worldwide for product development, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance
Amazon-10602955.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience in data-driven business operations processes
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Must be able to use Word, Excel, and other common desktop software applications. Must also be comfortable learning web applications and proprietary software

Preferred qualifications
- PhD in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent, or Doctorate/PhD or equivalent
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Hands on experience with Design Failure Mode Effective Analysis (D-FMEA), Process Failure Mode Effective Analysis (P-FMEA), Design of experience (DoE)
- Excellent business judgment, and a practical, common sense approach to getting things done
- Previous experience in retail consumer space for general, furniture, Textiles, home/kitchen non-electric, and/or electrics home/kitchen
- Creative thinking skills with emphasis on developing innovative solutions to solve complex problems that may not have one clear answer

Amazon-10493864.description:
2027年应届毕业生招聘-软件开发工程师（北京）
· 毕业时间：2026年10月 - 2027年7月之间
· 投递须知：
1 填写简历申请时，请把必填和非必填项都填写完整。提交简历之后就无法修改了哦！
2 学校的中英文全称请准确填写。
你是否希望通过创新技术解决现实的客户问题？你是否喜欢在合作的团队环境中开发可扩展的服务？你是否希望看到自己的代码直接影响全球数百万客户？
在亚马逊，我们招募技术领域最优秀的人才，代表客户进行创新和构建。客户至上是我们公司DNA的一部分，这使我们成为全球最受喜爱的品牌之一。
我们的软件开发工程师（SDE）使用现代技术解决复杂问题，同时能够亲眼见证自己工作的影响。SDE在亚马逊解决的挑战意义重大，影响着全球数百万客户、卖家和产品。我们寻找热衷于创造新产品、新功能和新服务的人才，他们能够在开发周期以周而非年为单位的环境中应对不确定性。
在亚马逊，我们相信每个级别的员工都应具备主人翁精神。作为SDE-I，你将负责代码的整个生命周期——从设计到部署再到持续运维。这种主人翁精神，结合我们对业务运营卓越性的承诺，确保我们为客户提供最高质量的解决方案。
我们正在寻找具有好奇心、志存高远并希望定义未来技术的人才。在亚马逊，你将在不断学习和相互支持的文化影响下，成长为你所期望的高影响力工程师。每一天都会带来令人兴奋的新挑战和个人成长的机会。
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
Key job responsibilities
•	与经验丰富的跨学科亚马逊同事进行有效的协作和沟通，设计、构建和运营令客户满意的创新产品和服务，同时参与技术讨论以推动解决方案的落地。
•	在大型分布式计算环境中，使用云原生架构和微服务设计并开发可扩展的解决方案。
•	参与代码审查并撰写技术文档。
•	构建和维护具有可扩展性、容错性和成本效益的弹性分布式系统。
•	利用并参与开发生成式AI和AI驱动的工具，以提升开发效率，同时紧跟新兴技术的发展。
•	遵循最佳实践和设计模式，编写简洁、可维护的代码。
•	在灵活的环境中工作，践行CI/CD原则，同时承担运营职责，包括值班轮岗。
•	通过监控、故障排查和解决生产问题，展现卓越运作能力。
•	Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
•	Design and develop scalable solutions using cloud-native architectures and microservices in a large distributed computing environment.
•	Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
•	Build and maintain resilient distributed systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective.
•	Leverage and contribute to the development of GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.
•	Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
•	Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
•	Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

- 云平台（优先考虑AWS）
- 数据库系统（SQL和NoSQL）
- 参与开源项目
- 版本控制系统
- 复杂系统的调试和故障排查
- 较强的问题解决和分析能力
- 优秀的书面和口头沟通能力
- 具备快速学习和适应新技术的能力
- 对软件开发生命周期（SDLC）有基本了解
- Previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
- Experience with one or more of the following:
- AI tools for development productivity
- Cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
- Database systems (SQL and NoSQL)
- Contributing to open-source projects
- Version control systems
- Debugging and troubleshooting complex systems
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly
- Basic understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)

Amazon-10501868.title: Sr Data Scientist, Seller Economics, WW Global Selling - PMO
Amazon-10501868.description:
Amazon WW Global Selling is looking for a dynamic, highly motivated Sr Data Scientist to join the central PMO team. This is an unique opportunity to:
Play a highly visible role in an exciting and fast paced business
Drive high impact products and initiatives to continuously improve Sellers' experience, growth and profitability
Innovate with advanced seller insights and influence cross-functional and global partners for great ideas and products.
Influence and drive decisions of senior leadership
This role is well-suited for someone with a strong economics or causal ML foundation who wants to apply rigorous statistical thinking to real product decisions at scale. You'll need to be comfortable writing SQL, working with imperfect data, and partnering with stakeholders to turn analysis into product impact. The ideal candidate will be strong at performing deep dives to derive insights on Seller behaviors, identify key pain points and needs from Seller perspective, and keen on AI-powered innovations, including:
1. Science-backed segmentation with a self-iterating feedback loop: Clustering algorithms (k-means, hierarchical, DBSCAN), Feature engineering from catalog and sales data, Feedback-loop model design, Ability to explain model logic to non-technical stakeholders
2. Econometric model to identify high expansion intent sellers: Propensity scoring and intent modeling (logistic regression, gradient boosting, neural), Behavioral sequence modeling, Feature engineering from sparse event-driven data, Classification threshold calibration
3. Post-Enrollment Outcome Models: Causal inference and treatment effect estimation (DiD, PSM, synthetic control, IV), A/B test design, Reinforcement learning
Science-backed graduation signals framework: Time series modeling and threshold detection, Survival analysis or time-to-event modeling, Bayesian updating for threshold calibration, Real-time or near-real-time scoring pipeline design
4. Familiarity with GenAI and LLM frameworks; experience embedding science models into AI-powered products or agents
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Use advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to extract insights from complex, large-scale data sets
- Partner with business/product stakeholders and senior science peers to identify strategic data-driven opportunities to improve the seller experience with a focus on seller economics domain
- Communicate findings, conclusions, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Stay up-to-date on the latest data science tools, techniques, and best practices and help evangelize them across the organization
- Design and implement end-to-end data science workflows, from data acquisition and cleaning to model development, testing, and deployment
- Support scalable, self-service data analyses by building datasets for analytics, reporting and ML use cases
About the team
We are WW Global Selling PMO team. We collaborate with WWGS business teams to identify key Seller needs and partner with global product teams to develop tools and solutions to improve Seller experience and sustainable growth.

Amazon-10581077.title: Sr MCAD Application Engineer, Design Technologies
Amazon-10581077.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?
Work hard. Have fun. Make history.
Amazon Lab126's Design Technologies (DT) team builds the CAD tooling, automation, and GenAI-powered services that hardware design teams across Amazon rely on. We're a global team of close to one hundred engineers across the US, India, and China, blending deep software engineering expertise with hands-on hardware and MCAD domain knowledge. We're now opening our first MCAD Application Engineer role in China to bring that support directly to our internal teams, vendors, and contract-manufacturing partners in the Asia region.
This is a senior, individually-driven role — and the first of its kind in China, which means you'll have the rare opportunity to define it from the ground up and own how DT shows up for an entire region. This is not a pure product design position; it combines mechanical/MCAD engineering depth with a field- and application-engineering mandate. You are the bridge between DT's tools and the engineers who use them — driving adoption through hands-on enablement, training, and evangelization, while applying your own mechanical engineering expertise to solve real design and manufacturing problems alongside your customers.
Our team's vision — and the heart of this role — is to collaborate closely with our software engineering team to enable AI in hardware design, reimagining how MCAD workflows are done at Lab126 through GenAI. You'll bring the hardware and MCAD domain knowledge that makes those tools genuinely useful, and carry them into the hands of the engineers building Amazon's devices. If you love working at the intersection of hardware, software, and people — and want the autonomy to build something new rather than inherit a playbook — this is a role where your work is visible, valued, and genuinely changes how great products get made.
Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
Enablement, support, and evangelization
- Drive adoption of DT's MCAD tools and services across Lab126 hardware design teams and their manufacturing partners, closing the gap between what DT builds and what teams actually use day to day.
- Support tool deployment and configuration — including CAD tool installation, environment setup, and troubleshooting issues raised by product teams.
- Organize and deliver training on new tools and workflows, both remotely and on-site, including travel to vendor and contract-manufacturing sites.
- Act as the voice of the customers in Asia: collect requirements, surface pain points, and feed them back to the DT engineering team.
- Partner closely with the software engineers who develop and customize these tools, translating hardware and MCAD domain knowledge for audiences of different technical backgrounds.
- Help shape the next generation of DT tooling, which is increasingly built on GenAI technologies (RAG, agents) with the vision of enabling MCAD design workflows through GenAI.
Applied mechanical/MCAD engineering
- Apply hands-on mechanical and MCAD expertise to help teams solve feature design, tolerance, and manufacturability problems using DT's tools.
- Support failure analysis and solution validation for design and production issues surfaced by product and manufacturing teams.
- Advise on product design/development best practices (DFM, tolerance analysis, GD&T) as part of tool enablement.
- Identify engineering use-cases and translate them into requirements that inform DT's software development.
Amazon-10581077.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 7+ years of new hardware products development experience
- Knowledge of industry standard CAD & FEA design tools, industry trends, and design for manufacturability
- Deep, hands-on expertise using Creo for mechanical design, including injection-molded parts and sheet metal.
- Proven ability to work independently and drive cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable socializing with and influencing engineers, customers, and manufacturing partners.
- Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken).
- Experience with Windchill PLM/PDM.

Preferred qualifications
- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- 10+ years of hardware engineering experience
- Experience developing products for large volume production
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Experience with leading and delivering technical training
- Six-Sigma or equivalent certification

Amazon-10574023.title: Sr. HW Regulatory Compliance Engineer
Amazon-10574023.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Echo, Ring, and Blink — icons of ambient computing reaching hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. What will you help us create?
The Hardware Safety & Compliance (HWSC) team is the critical bridge between bold hardware innovation and worldwide market access. We don't just check boxes — we embed compliance into the DNA of product design from Day 1, ensuring that hundreds of millions of devices meet the highest standards for safety, electromagnetic compatibility, and radio frequency performance across 100+ countries.
We're looking for a Sr. HW Regulatory Compliance Engineer based in China who excels at hands-on execution of compliance testing, certification, and factory-level validation across our product portfolio. You will work closely with contract manufacturers (CMs), in-region test laboratories, and cross-functional engineering teams to drive EMC and RF compliance from engineering builds through mass production. You will be experienced in Radio Frequency (RF) and ElectroMagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing, debugging, and product certification processes. You will have strong familiarity with North American and international regulatory standards. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to validate and certify innovative wireless consumer electronic products.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused engineering role where your work directly determines whether Amazon can achieve certification milestones on schedule and maintain compliance across production lines. You will be the HWSC team's on-the-ground presence in China — coordinating test lab activities, supporting CM builds, debugging compliance issues in real time, and ensuring production units meet all certification requirements. This role requires approximately 20% travel to test laboratories and CM sites. You must be analytical, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively across multiple teams and time zones. Additionally, you must excel at communicating compliance status and technical findings clearly to both local engineering teams and global HWSC leadership.
Key job responsibilities
• Execute end-to-end compliance testing and certification activities for product programs — from engineering builds through mass production, ensuring all regulatory milestones are met on schedule
• Work closely with the product design team by researching and specifying regulatory and industry compliance requirements, with emphasis on China, FCC, IC, CE, and other international certification schemes
• Drive hands-on EMI/EMC and RF compliance testing and debugging — partnering with Electrical, Mechanical, and Wireless engineers to resolve compliance issues at the circuit, layout, firmware, or mechanical design level
• Manage day-to-day relationships with in-region 3rd party test laboratories — planning, scheduling, and directing compliance testing to drive first-pass certification success
• Support CM site compliance activities — validating that production configurations, shielding, grounding, and assembly processes maintain compliance established during development
• Debug compliance failures at the root-cause level — understanding why at the circuit, layout, firmware, or mechanical design level, and driving the fix with engineering teams in real time
• Coordinate with global HWSC team members to align on compliance strategies, share test results, and escalate issues that may impact product launch timelines
• Perform detailed, independent research and literature reviews to yield actionable conclusions to ambiguous regulatory compliance issues
• Deliver concise and informative compliance status updates to global HWSC leadership, translating test results and certification progress into clear schedule impact assessments
• Work with manufacturing partners to test and ensure all in-production devices remain compliant with all certifications, including production line testing validation
• Maintain compliance documentation, test reports, and certification records with thoroughness and accuracy to support audits and market access filings
• Contribute to best practices and mechanisms that prevent repeat compliance issues and improve certification efficiency across the device portfolio

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience in a consumer electronics lab environment
- Working proficiency in Mandarin and English (written and verbal) to coordinate across local and global teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience working with Contract Manufacturers (CM) and test lab on compliance-related issues and certifications.
- Experience with wireless technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee/Thread, UWB, or Cellular

Amazon-10499392.title: Sr. Supplier Quality Manager, Amazon Private Brands
Amazon-10499392.description:
Are you ready to redefine what quality means in e-commerce? This role goes beyond conventional quality assurance. As a Supplier Quality Manager within Amazon Private Brands, you will own the full quality value chain, from decoding customer experiences through review ratings and return analytics, to driving manufacturing excellence at supplier sites, to optimizing end-to-end internal processes that deliver the highest quality products. If you thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and cross-industry problem solving, this role offers a platform to lead, learn, and make global impact.
In this role, you will leverage AI and intelligent agents to scale quality programs across a diverse portfolio spanning multiple industries. You will work across the full spectrum of quality, from customer experience analytics to supplier manufacturing performance, bringing insights back to test, optimize, and design internal processes that drive meaningful improvements. This is a strategic, cross-functional leadership position where you connect customer intelligence, supplier performance, and engineering innovation to deliver measurable business outcomes at speed.
Key job responsibilities
•	Analyze customer experience data (Customer Review Ratings, Returns, feedback signals) to identify quality trends, uncover root causes, and translate customer insights into actionable improvement strategies across a diverse product portfolio spanning hardlines and consumables
•	Partner directly with suppliers / manufacturing sites to drive sustained quality and production efficiencies; implement preventive measures and build supplier capabilities that deliver consistent product excellence at scale
•	Bridge customer and supplier insights to test and optimize internal end-to-end processes; drive systemic improvements that enhance quality outcomes across the entire value chain, from sourcing through delivery
•	Engage global stakeholders across diverse functions; communicate data-driven recommendations and quality strategies that shape business decisions and drive cross-functional alignment
•	Leverage AI and intelligent agents to design scalable quality solutions, automate monitoring and evaluation, and amplify your impact across a multi-industry product portfolio; pioneer next-generation quality methodologies tailored for e-commerce at scale

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, material engineering, mechanical engineering or related fields
- Experience in auditing, risk management, compliance, program management, or quality management systems

- Fluent in Mandarin and English; excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong analytical mindset with ability to synthesize customer and operational data into strategic recommendations; creative problem-solving skills

SDE北京 - 适合2024届，2025届和2026届毕业同学，即：0-2年以内工作经验的同学 申请投递。
· 毕业时间：2024年6月 - 2026年6月之间毕业的同学（例如毕业后已经就业，工作经验在0-2年以内均可投递）
· 工作地点：北京朝阳区
· 投递须知：
1 填写简历申请时，请把必填和非必填项都填写完整。提交简历之后就无法修改了哦！

你想通过创新技术解决业务挑战吗?你喜欢与团队一起研究尖端的、可扩展的服务技术吗?你愿意参与可以推动行业发展的核心项目吗?为了服务亚⻢逊的客户，我们正在寻找顶尖的技术人才进行创新。顾客至尚的理念使我们成为 全球最受欢迎的品牌之一，这一观念已成为我们公司DNA的一部分。我们的软件开发工程师(Software Development Engineer)擅⻓运用尖端技术来解决复杂的问题，影响着数以亿计的用户，并亲眼目睹其工作对世界产生的影响。作为SDE在亚⻢逊需要面对巨大的技术挑战，能否解决这些挑战将影响全球的数百万的买家，卖家和产品。我们正在寻找对从头开始研发新产品，新功能，新服务充满热情的年轻人。
Key job responsibilities
岗位描述
· 与经验丰富的团队合作，构思，设计创新的产品和服务，将其推向市场。
· 在大型分布式计算环境中设计和构建创新技术，并帮助引领行业的变革。
· 规模化、快速地使用创新技术，在分布式系统上创建解决方案进行预测。
· 构建可扩展，容错，低成本且易于管理的分布式存储、索引、查询系统。
· 设计解决方案并进行编码，解决广泛的技术问题。
· 在敏捷环境中工作，交付高质量的软件。
岗位要求
· 计算机科学，软件，自动化或相关领域的本科/研究生/博士。
· 熟悉Java，C / C++或Python等语言。
· 具备计算机科学基础知识，例如面向对象设计，算法设计，数据结构和复杂性分析。
加分项
· 具有分布式，多层系统，算法或关系数据库的经验。
· 在数学方面的经验，例如线性规划或非线性优化。
· 可以有效表述技术问题并提供解决方案。
· 具备抽象思考的能力，善于解决复杂的问题。
Amazon-10399403.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 计算机科学，软件，自动化或相关领域的本科/研究生/博士。

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in software development

Amazon-10594211.title: ACT Ops Associate(Part-time), Amazon Customs & Trade
Amazon-10594211.description:
Following SOP and other requirement to validate data/information provided by customer.
Contacting with customer if the data/information is unclear/incorrect.
Key in the data/information in system. Make sure the data/information in system is correct and align with SOP/requirement.
Escalating issues and problems encountered in daily work.
Collaborating with origin and destination logistics teams and other service providers to solve shipment issues
Act as 1st Tier support for Seller Service queries related to shipments
Any Add-hoc task assigned by leaders.
Key job responsibilities
2+ years working experiences
Work at flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays if needed
Good at MS Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).
Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize workloads, maintain a strong attention to detail, and work independently.
Customer oriented mindset, have a sense of urgency in completing all departmental and personal goals
Willing to take additional duties/tasks assigned by leadership as business related services and products continue to expand.
Good written/read communication skills in English
About the team
The ACT operations team is a team of customs brokers managing the import duty requirements of FBA and external products. We have INLT LLC in US (a subsidiary of Amazon) and 3rd party customs broker in EU & UK, responsible for filing customs entries for goods.
We are the provider of choice for industry-leading customs and trade services for universal importers and exporters, bringing value to traders by simplifying processes, ensuring accuracy, reducing costs, and providing a one-stop suite of trusted solutions.
Amazon-10594211.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Microsoft Office suite) including Word, Excel, and Outlook in a professional environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
- Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e.g., UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc.)
- Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration
