Amazon-10597376.title: Electrical Engineer, HW Sustaining
Amazon-10597376.description:
As a Sustaining Electrical Engineer, you will be the electrical technical owner for multiple Amazon device programs from mass production through end of life. You will lead the investigation and resolution of major hardware quality issues reported by customers, drive related hardware design changes, qualify alternate hardware components, spearhead cost-reduction engineering initiatives, and lead hardware failure analyses that significantly impact manufacturing yield. Each decision weighs electrical risk against cost, schedule and customer impact. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical bar across a broad portfolio, make data-driven calls when requirements are ambiguous, and influence US-based design teams and manufacturing partners without direct authority.
This role requires approximately 30% travel to ODM/CM partner sites across Greater China.
Key job responsibilities
•	Own electrical sustaining engineering for multiple programs across the Echo, Fire TV, eReader and Tablet portfolios
•	Lead electrical evaluation and qualification of alternate / second-source components (memory, PMIC, DC/DC, passives, connectors), defining validation plans and sign-off criteria
•	Assess supplier PCN / EOL notifications (e.g., fab transfer, die revision, process change) for electrical risk, and drive qualification or last-time-buy decisions
•	Identify and drive cost-reduction engineering changes, balancing BOM savings against electrical risk and validation effort
•	Drive root cause and corrective action on mass-production yield issues and field returns through failure analysis and bench debug
•	Provide engineering validation for factory and line transfers, ensuring electrical conformance at the new site
•	Develop and execute electrical validation test plans to ensure functional and parametric conformance, and report status at milestone gates
•	Raise the technical bar across the team by setting validation standards, reviewing peers' analyses, and mentoring junior electrical engineers
•	Use AI tools and write scripts to automate validation, data analysis and reporting where feasible
About the team
Amazon Devices Sustaining Engineering owns Amazon's consumer electronics after launch, covering Echo, Fire TV, eReader and Tablet products. Our job is to keep these products high quality, cost-competitive and supply-resilient for their whole production life. We work closely with US-based design teams, global supply chain and our ODM/CM partners across Greater China.
Amazon-10597376.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- BSEE with 10+ years, or MSEE with 8+ years, of experience in consumer electronics design, validation and/or manufacturing
- 4+ years of experience leading and working with ODM/OEM/CM partners across product development and mass production
- Experience with system-level hardware including circuit design, system bring-up, integration and debug
- Experience in power regulation (AC-DC / DC-DC) and power management design, including schematic, layout review, validation and debug
- Strong EE fundamentals and hands-on failure analysis and troubleshooting skills in a laboratory and factory environment
- Knowledge of processor architecture, digital circuit design and communication protocols such as I2C, UART, SPI, USB, MIPI and I2S
- Experience developing robust designs for ESD/EMI immunity and RF de-sensitization
- Experience with schematic entry, layout review and design for manufacturability
- English and Mandarin language skills

Preferred qualifications
- Master's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in wireless system design and architecture, system integration, and RF system analysis
- Experience with memory technologies (eMMC, UFS, DRAM, NAND), including component qualification and debug
- Experience with high-speed design, signal integrity tools and noise suppression techniques, especially discrete DDR
- Experience with audio front-end electrical design and validation using Audio Precision
- Knowledge of battery management systems and battery-powered wireless embedded devices
- Familiarity with OrCAD Capture and Cadence Allegro tool flow
- Automation and scripting experience (e.g., Python, shell)
- Complete understanding of manufacturing processes, including DFM and DFT for consumer products
- Strong communication and documentation skills, and the ability to influence cross-functional and cross-region teams while operating autonomously

Amazon-10596135.title: Hardware Development Engineer, Asia Development Center
Amazon-10596135.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced groundbreaking devices like Kindle, Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?
The Role will support circuit and board-level design, participate in system bring-up and debug activities, and work with ODM/OEM partners through various stages of product development. You will collaborate with firmware and software teams to resolve hardware-software integration issues, analyze field returns and failure data to identify root causes, and contribute to design improvements for ESD/EMI performance and power management. Travel to partner sites is part of the role, with opportunities to work on-site with manufacturing and development partners.
To be successful you need to be highly motivated, understand how to solve problems and dive deep while delivering to the highest standards. You will demonstrate a strong working knowledge of product electrical design with expertise in systems integration, the desire to learn from new challenges, and the problem-solving and communication skills to work within a highly interactive and experienced team.
Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Lead multiple electrical design and validation on multiple products across Amazon device portfolio
- Research test/validation technologies and methodologies across factory and lab environment
- Develop and execute detailed electrical validation test plans to ensure functional and parametric conformance for various sub-systems including Memory
- Drive debug and root cause of hardware design issues, qualifying trade-offs and user impact
- Support integration of memory components into the broad range of Amazon HW devices.
- Provide on-site electrical engineering support at manufacturing facilities in China
- Drive hardware bring-up, debug, and failure analysis at manufacturing sites
- Support Design for Manufacturing (DFM) initiatives and manufacturing process optimization
- Own and resolve electrical design issues across xVT phases, while driving validation status reporting across mile-stone gates
- Leverage AI tools and/or write scripts where feasible to automate for efficiency
- Support positive team interactions to accomplish program objectives
- Coach or mentor junior electrical engineers
Amazon-10596135.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience in motherboard design, PCB design including schematic capture, stackup and circuit board layout
- Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with 2+ years of experience in consumer electronic product design, OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE)
- 1+ years of experience with system-level circuit design, system bring-up, integration, or debug
- 1+ years of experience with low-power circuit design, DC/DC converters, or power management circuits
- Knowledge of processor architecture, digital circuit design and various communications protocols such as I2C, UART, USB, etc.
- 1+ years of experience working with ODM/OEMs across product development stages (design, build, test)

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in wireless system design and architecture, system integration, and RF system analysis
- Experience with analog, digital, and high-speed circuit design
- Experience with mixed-signal board-level design
- Experience with digital circuit design and communication protocols such as I2C, UART, SPI, USB, MIPI, or I2S
- Experience developing designs for ESD/EMI immunity and RF de-sensitization
- Experience designing products for wireless networks (GSM, UMTS, LTE)
- Experience with DFM and DFT processes for consumer electronics manufacturing
- Experience collaborating with software or firmware teams on drivers, firmware, or algorithms
- Experience communicating technical concepts and design trade-offs to cross-functional team members

Amazon-10553042.title: Mechanical Process Engineer, Product Engineering
Amazon-10553042.description:
Amazon is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers’ high-profile, consumer electronics products, like the Kindle, Kindle Fire, Fire TV and Echo, etc. The products we design and engineer are easy-to-use and offer users benefits that are only made possible through tightly integrated digital technologies and wireless connectivity.
The Mechanical Process Engineer (MPE) works closely with teams located in both the US and China throughout the design cycle. As a member of the MPE team, you will be responsible for developing mechanical part manufacturing, decoration and sub-assembly processes, providing design recommendations to the design team (ID & PD), driving engineering studies, and improving part yield rate. You will be responsible for closely monitoring and driving the above activities at suppliers.
In addition, you will work closely with the Technical Program Management (TPM) team on giving timely feedback of technical risk, and continuous communication of the status of engineering issues throughout the product development cycle to a cross functional audience. You will be the primary contact window for technical issue resolution across the supply base.
The Role:
• Identify and develop mechanical part manufacturing and decorative processes
• Review and develop part/sub-assembly process flow, including process fixture concept and DFM
• Develop supplier process capability through continuous engagement and engineering studies
• Provide design feedback and recommendations including features and tolerances
• Drive and approve technical data documentation throughout the development cycle including FAI, CMK, CPK, GR&R, and DFM
• Drive technical issue resolution at suppliers throughout the development cycle
• Mentor and develop junior engineers
• Identify technical risks and define mitigation plan
• Travel domestically and internationally to supplier sites as projects require
Amazon-10553042.requirements:

- Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Dive deep mechanical process development and trouble shooting experience in either metal or plastic parts
- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills including working knowledge of data analysis and statistics. Familiar with GR&R and DOE.
- Experience delivering products to volume production
- Knowlege of Mechanical Design or Tooling Engineering.
- Able to lead a project with minimum guidance, and escalate risk or issues clearly to the management team.
- Experience working onsite with manufacturers and suppliers.
- Familiarity with Pro/Engineer and MS office suite

Preferred qualifications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Mandarin
- Experience using statistical tools such as Minitab
- Knowledge of agile product development and life-cycle management process
- Advanced technical degree
- Certified Six Sigma Green Belt or higher
- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Amazon-10605709.title: Selling Partner Support Associate
Amazon-10605709.description:
Seller Support at AMAZON
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The Seller Support team acts as the primary interface between Amazon and our 3rd party sellers.  We obsess over providing world class support to 3rd party Sellers on the Amazon platform.  We strive to predict the Seller's needs before they recognize they may need our support, create innovative self-help tools, and provide solutions to help our partners better serve their customers.
Position Description: Global Seller Support Associate
LOCATION: Virtual Location (Chengdu, CN)
LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS (Chinese/English)
SHIFT REQUIREMENTS (Per Business requirement)
Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrates effective, clear and professional written and oral communication.
- Provides prompt and efficient service to Amazon Sellers and Merchants including the appropriate escalation of Sellers’ issues.
- Maintains a positive and professional demeanor always portraying the company in a positive light and effectively managing sensitive issues.
- Demonstrates excellent time-management skills and the ability to work independently while using departmental resources, policies and procedures.
- Contributes to a positive team environment and proactively aids team members with difficult contacts as needed.
- Maintains acceptable performance metrics such as quality, productivity, first contact resolution, and attendance.
- Actively seeks solutions through logical reasoning and data interpretation skills and identifies trends to appropriate channel including improvement suggestions.

Amazon-10529177.title: Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer, QxAME
Amazon-10529177.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development  company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics.  Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally  creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have  produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Echo  and Amazon Show. The Amazon Devices group delivers delightfully unique  Amazon experiences, giving customers instant access to everything,  digital or physical.
We disrupt manufacturing with latest technological solutions while digitizing assembly and now we are taking it to the next level.
Key job responsibilities
As an Senior MDE Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and  implementing DFMA good practices to the design of our product. You will  be a key member of the development team and will be the main interface  between the Hardware and Product Design Engineering teams with local and  Offshore Operations teams within Lab126 and our OEM partners. In this  role, you will:
- Work with design engineering to identify      and escalate  manufacturing challenges by enforcing DFM, DFA and DFS      principles
- Investigate and introduce new      manufacturing technology and  methodology to enhance product quality and      production efficiency
- Develop manufacturing process at the ODM,      including  defining fixture requirements, critical dimensions on parts and       critical requirements in assembly
- Drive all factory-related operational      issues related to  final assembly processes during pre-production builds;      ensure  effective closure to enable operational success of the new product       introduction cycle, and put products into mass production
- Identify and develop assembly jig and      fixture for new products
- Work within Operations, Hardware, and      Product Design  engineering departments to implement and optimize      manufacturing 1st  pass yields and efficiency from prototype through      product ramp
- Bridge the gap from OEM to Lab126 by      supporting development builds and production
- Support cost reduction and sustaining activities
A day in the life
In a dynamic environment collaboratively executing design reviews, making plans with instructions on how the assembly will be achieved in a well architected manufacturing environment.
About the team
Highly skilled individuals working collaboratively to solve complex issues and coming up with new ways to improve the overall product design to delight our customers.
Amazon-10529177.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience in mechanical assembly, including Tolerance Analysis and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
- Experience in mechanical metrology, including OMM, Displacement Lasers, Accelerometers, Confocal Microscopy, and other inspection equipment.
- Experience in process characterization and validation using statistical tools such as SPC, GR&R, Cp/Cpk, Design of Experiments.
- Experience with design for manufacturability, design for automation, and creating process documentation from scratch
- Experience with assembly jig and fixture design
- Experience working with International OEM Partners

Preferred qualifications
- Master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Ability to work independently and ensure timely and accurate communication between the Lab126 and our OEM partners
- Good understanding of manufacturing strategy and DFMA best practices
- Experienced with CAD, CREO preferred
- Experience with Statistical Analysis Software, Minitab, JMP, MATLAB, etc.
- Experience in Mechanical FEA, Abaqus, COMSOL, ANSYS, etc.
- Mechanically inclined, strong problem-solving skills, hands-on individual
- Excellent oral and written communication skills; capable of interfacing at all levels of a business from equipment operators to platform VP

for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Amazon-10600896.title: Sr. Associate JP, Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC)
Amazon-10600896.description:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.
Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Compliance Associate, your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.
Required Skills:
• Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
• Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
• Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
• Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
• Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
• Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
• Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data

Amazon-10601953.title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, HW Sustaining
Amazon-10601953.description:
As a Sustaining Electrical Engineer, you will be the senior electrical technical owner for multiple Amazon device programs from mass production through end of life. You will lead the investigation and resolution of major hardware quality issues reported by customers, drive related hardware design changes, qualify alternate hardware components, spearhead cost-reduction engineering initiatives, and lead hardware failure analyses that significantly impact manufacturing yield. Each decision weighs electrical risk against cost, schedule and customer impact. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical bar across a broad portfolio, make data-driven calls when requirements are ambiguous, and influence US-based design teams and manufacturing partners without direct authority.
This role requires approximately 30% travel to ODM/CM partner sites across Greater China.
Key job responsibilities
•	Own electrical sustaining engineering for multiple programs across the Echo, Fire TV, eReader and Tablet portfolios
•	Lead electrical evaluation and qualification of alternate / second-source components (memory, PMIC, DC/DC, passives, connectors), defining validation plans and sign-off criteria
•	Assess supplier PCN / EOL notifications (e.g., fab transfer, die revision, process change) for electrical risk, and drive qualification or last-time-buy decisions
•	Identify and drive cost-reduction engineering changes, balancing BOM savings against electrical risk and validation effort
•	Drive root cause and corrective action on mass-production yield issues and field returns through failure analysis and bench debug
•	Provide engineering validation for factory and line transfers, ensuring electrical conformance at the new site
•	Develop and execute electrical validation test plans to ensure functional and parametric conformance, and report status at milestone gates
•	Raise the technical bar across the team by setting validation standards, reviewing peers' analyses, and mentoring junior electrical engineers
•	Use AI tools and write scripts to automate validation, data analysis and reporting where feasible
About the team
Amazon Devices Sustaining Engineering owns Amazon's consumer electronics after launch, covering Echo, Fire TV, eReader and Tablet products. Our job is to keep these products high quality, cost-competitive and supply-resilient for their whole production life. We work closely with US-based design teams, global supply chain and our ODM/CM partners across Greater China.
Amazon-10601953.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- BSEE with 10+ years, or MSEE with 8+ years, of experience in consumer electronics design, validation and/or manufacturing
- 4+ years of experience leading and working with ODM/OEM/CM partners across product development and mass production
- Experience with system-level hardware including circuit design, system bring-up, integration and debug
- Experience in power regulation (AC-DC / DC-DC) and power management design, including schematic, layout review, validation and debug
- Strong EE fundamentals and hands-on failure analysis and troubleshooting skills in a laboratory and factory environment
- Knowledge of processor architecture, digital circuit design and communication protocols such as I2C, UART, SPI, USB, MIPI and I2S
- Experience developing robust designs for ESD/EMI immunity and RF de-sensitization
- Experience with schematic entry, layout review and design for manufacturability
- English and Mandarin language skills

Preferred qualifications
- Master's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in wireless system design and architecture, system integration, and RF system analysis

Amazon-10589576.title: Sr. Silicon & Systems Engineer
Amazon-10589576.description:
Amazon Devices is an inventive research and development company that designs and develops high-profile devices like the Kindle family of products, Fire Tablets, Alexa, Fire TV, Health Wellness, Amazon Echo & Astro products.  This is an exciting opportunity to join Amazon in contributing to its next generation SOC’s for the machine learning enabled consumer products.
As a Sr. Silicon & Systems Engineer, in Silicon Validation team,  you will play a pivotal role in deploying SOCs in development and production phases of products by collaborating with multi-functional teams and leading the RCA (Root Cause Analysis) activities for failures pointing to silicon.  You will be responsible for developing, maintaining test code/methodology to debug silicon/SOC issues and drive root cause failure analysis.
Key job responsibilities
- Drive RCA(Root Cause Analysis) activities for failures pointing to silicon, in development and production phases of the product by collaborating with multi-functional teams.
- Develop & Drive qualification activities for peripheral parts like memories & storage based on customer (product team) requirements.
- Support product teams with appropriate design collateral. Update and maintain the design collateral as needed. Offering timely design reviews from a silicon standpoint.
- Risk Management : Drive containment, risk assessment & mitigation activities related to silicon/hardware failures.
- Craft integration/debug strategy for new HW features in system level, including specifications, validation plans, debug methodology as needed, across (but not limited to) Validation and ATE environments.
Amazon-10589576.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- - Extensive experience in the Semiconductor industry.
- - Good understanding of ARM V8/V9 Architecture, familiar with Multimedia SoC key hardware features.
- - Experience with the system engineering, expertise in Linux OS low layer interactive with the Silicon and related debug methodology.
- - Experience with SOC bring-up and post-silicon validation.
- - Experience leading technical initiatives and key deliverables.
- - Experience working with software teams to tightly define the HW/SW interface.

Preferred qualifications
- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- - Experience developing products for volume production and resolving the issue happen in mass production phase.
- - Experience in Bare Metal Environment development, including linker scripts, page tables and NVIC.
- - Experience in high-speed interface(like DDR/HDMI/EMMC/USB/PCIe) specification and enabling/debugging.
- - Experience in practical semiconductor design work including full-chip and subsystem integration.

Amazon-10491143.title: Technical Program Manager, Hardware Development
Amazon-10491143.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced groundbreaking devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?
As a Hardware Technical Program Manager, you will engage with an experienced inter-disciplinary staff to conceive and design innovative consumer products. You will work closely with an internal inter-disciplinary team together to drive key aspects of product definition, execution, test and delivery. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.
The Hardware Technical Program Manager will lead internal inter-disciplinary teams through the product execution phase process. The candidate will work with oversea team to create the project plan, including the schedule. You will work with the Product Manager to derive the product requirements and obtain executive approval. The Hardware Technical Program Manager will drive and motivate the cross-functional team to deliver the product(s) as per the agreed-to requirements and cross-functionally manage other internal team members. The Hardware Technical Program Manager will be responsible for the coordination, and provide assistance planning of all engineering builds at the supplier and driving the configuration management deliverables to ensure the timely release of all assemblies to production. In this role, you will:
· Drive execution of projects
· Lead cross functional project meetings
· Lead milestone reviews
· Present project status to the executive team
· Provide Suggestion for managing project builds globally
This position will require domestic and international travel.
Amazon-10491143.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Preferred qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Solid understanding of product development process; Proficient at creating and tracking complex development schedules, managing issues and tracking bugs

Amazon-10606895.title: Data Center Technical Support Operations Engr, AWS Infra-operation DCEO
Amazon-10606895.description:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Services team provides comprehensive technical support throughout the design, planning, delivery, and operation of Amazon Web Services infrastructure. We support data centers and  the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure the customers of Amazon Web Services have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations technical support managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across Amazon and our operating partners to help Amazon Web Services deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for the customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Data Center Technical Support Engineering Operations Technician (EOT )is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
EOT’s are data center's front line responders for support electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities:
English (both written and spoken English) as standard language to fulfill responsibilities below
- Support maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assist root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal SLA
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Support take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Able to work a 12 hour shift  to support 24/7 operations (rotating 3 to 4 day work weeks)
About the team
About Amazon Web Services
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Web Services values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Web Services?
Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Amazon Web Services pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust Amazon Web Services’ robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Amazon Web Services values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

As an Account Manager, You are expected to be fluent in Japanese and preferably well-versed in Japanese business etiquette, as you will be directly supporting vendors in the JP retail market. You will serve directly with vendors and manage aspects of their businesses on the Amazon platform. Through in-depth data analysis and market trend insights, you will assist vendors in developing practical and effective business strategies, driving business growth, and achieving revenue goals, while continuously optimizing key manufacturers’ (vendors') overall performance on the Amazon platform.
Your core responsibilities will focus on day-to-day communication with vendors, strategy formulation, business reporting, and relationship maintenance, ensuring that vendor needs are promptly responded to, solutions are efficiently executed, and long-term stable cooperation is achieved.
Key job responsibilities
- Continuously monitor daily operational data, proactively identify potential risks, ensure the effective execution of strategies, and make timely adjustments as necessary to maintain smooth business operations.
- Based on data, propose feasible optimization solutions to improve the vendor’s performance in supply chain efficiency, traffic acquisition, conversion rates, etc., thereby driving overall sales growth.
- Maintain frequent and high-quality communication with vendors, deeply understand their business needs and concerns, ensure issues are promptly responded to and effectively resolved, and build strong trust and collaborative relationships.
- Provide regular professional and systematic business reports to vendors, clearly communicate goal progress based on quantifiable data, outline future strategic directions and key initiatives, and analyze the core reasons and business implications behind the data.
- Work with vendors to define and achieve business targets.
- Provide weekly reports to relevant internal teams to ensure transparency and promote cross-team collaboration.
- Collaborate closely with internal functional teams, actively coordinate resources, and secure necessary support to help vendors achieve sustainable business growth.

Amazon-10602592.title: Account Manager, Vendor Management, Retail Business Services (RBS)
Amazon-10602592.description:
About Amazon.com
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company  where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy  online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast  selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a  world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to  e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of  innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest  technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology  that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
About the Role
As an Account Manager, you are expected to demonstrate fluency in Japanese with substantial business experience in Japan, particularly in the online retail or e-commerce space. You should possess strong data analysis and business proposal capabilities, along with proficiency in leveraging AI to develop automation tools. You will own a specific product category and be responsible for identifying the most critical issues within a given period by analyzing fluctuations in key input metrics, conducting deep-dive analysis to uncover common root causes, and setting clear priorities to determine which vendors require one-on-one negotiation and which call for scaled solutions. You will also own the improvement of a designated key input metric within your scope, deeply analyzing the common drivers behind its fluctuations and fully leveraging AI to create automated solutions that address the top contributing factors at scale.
Key job responsibilities
1. Conduct in-depth data analysis on key input metrics such as selection, traffic, conversion, and profitability to identify growth opportunities and develop targeted, high-impact business proposals.
2. Negotiate directly with vendors on a one-on-one basis to secure commitment and drive actionable outcomes aligned with category goals.
3. Take ownership of category-level performance by continuously monitoring trends across key input metrics, diagnosing common root causes behind performance gaps, and designing scalable operational initiatives that drive improvement across the entire vendor portfolio.
4. Lead projects that leverage AI-powered tools and automation to build end-to-end operational workflows, reducing manual intervention and enabling the team to operate at greater scale and efficiency.
5. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to align on priorities, share best practices, and contribute to the continuous evolution of the team's operating model.
About the team
The vision of RBS MVR team is “To unlock the full potential of every vendor on Amazon through an intelligent scaling engine, that transforms how we recruit, launch, and grow our partners to deliver unparalleled selection and value to customers worldwide".
Amazon-10602592.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree
- 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes
- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Influencing and metrics management skills — ability to understand business metrics and create realistic forecasts; strong negotiation skills.

Preferred qualifications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 3+ years of sales or account management experience
- Knowledge of SQL, Python, Selenium and VBA
- - Study experience in Japan preferred.
- - Experience working in a Japanese local company preferred.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit

Amazon-10603945.title: Account Rep
Amazon-10603945.description:
Are you ready to help businesses unlock their full potential on Amazon? We are looking for a motivated and analytical Account Representative to join our team and work directly with partners to grow their presence and performance. In this role, you will manage customer relationships, analyze data to uncover opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations that drive meaningful results. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and serve as a trusted point of contact for your portfolio of accounts, helping them navigate solutions and achieve their goals. If you are curious, resourceful, and energized by building strong partnerships, this is the role for you.
Key job responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of accounts by developing tailored strategies, setting clear timelines, and maintaining consistent communication to support partner growth and satisfaction.
- Analyze account performance data using tools such as Excel and SQL to identify trends, surface opportunities, and deliver data-driven recommendations to your partners.
- Prepare and deliver compelling business reviews and presentations that highlight progress, address challenges, and outline strategic next steps for your accounts.
- Collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot operational issues, remove roadblocks, and ensure a smooth experience for your partners across Amazon's platform.
- Evaluate opportunities to integrate generative AI tools into your workflows to improve productivity, streamline reporting, and enhance the quality of your insights.
A day in the life
Your morning might start with reviewing account metrics and preparing a business review for one of your key partners. By midday, you could be presenting performance insights and discussing growth strategies on a call with a client. In the afternoon, you might work with internal teams to resolve an operational challenge or dig into data to uncover a new opportunity for an account. Throughout it all, you are building relationships, sharpening your analytical skills, and making a tangible impact on partner success.
About the team
Our team is dedicated to helping Amazon's partners succeed by providing strategic guidance, hands-on support, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive environment where every team member can learn, contribute, and grow. As we continue to expand, you will play a key role in shaping how we work with partners and drive results. If you are excited about joining a team that values curiosity, initiative, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Amazon-10597326.title: Assembly Operator Intern, RIVR
Amazon-10597326.description:
●	在资深技术人员指导下，协助完成机器人零组件（不带电部分）的装配工作，包括关节、结构部件、线束等。学习并遵循装配工艺要求与操作规范，保质保量完成分配的装配任务。
Key job responsibilities
●	接受安全生产规则制度的培训，认真领悟安全生产的重要性，并学会正确的产线生产规范及个人防护。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，认识并熟悉产线物料，并能分别不同物料，学会盘点产线物料，及库存物料，了解物料管理制度并及时报告产线缺料问题。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，认识产线装配工具和日常设备，学习正确使用工具。并在资深装配员的监督下，尝试使用各种产线日常设备。
●	在资深装配员指导下，参与车间 5S 管理。学习保持工位整洁有序，规范存放物料与工具。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，学习阅读作业指导书，并在资深装配员的监督下完成分配的装配任务。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，观摩测试工作，了解产品续测试环节涉及的步骤及造成残次品原因的装配原因。
●	记录所观摩到的装配过程、基础测试台操作、物料清点步骤，在实习期结束形成完整的实习报告。
About the team
作为亚马逊旗下一员，RIVR 致力于通过真实的末端配送场景开拓具身智能（Physical AI）的前沿应用。公司于 2024 年脱胎于苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich），专注于研发能够在楼梯、门禁通道和高低不平的城市路面等复杂非结构化环境中稳定运行的轮腿式机器人。我们深信，要实现真正的通用物理智能，必须立足于解决现实世界中的实际需求，让机器人在海量且真实的运营数据中持续进化。
自 2026 年 3 月加入亚马逊以来，我们在更大规模与更快节奏下继续推进这一愿景。结合定制机器人硬件、机载自主导航与云端协同控制能力，亚马逊旗下的 RIVR 正在构建下一代更安全、更可靠的最后一公里自主配送机器人。

Amazon-10597326.full_text:
●	在资深技术人员指导下，协助完成机器人零组件（不带电部分）的装配工作，包括关节、结构部件、线束等。学习并遵循装配工艺要求与操作规范，保质保量完成分配的装配任务。
Key job responsibilities
●	接受安全生产规则制度的培训，认真领悟安全生产的重要性，并学会正确的产线生产规范及个人防护。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，认识并熟悉产线物料，并能分别不同物料，学会盘点产线物料，及库存物料，了解物料管理制度并及时报告产线缺料问题。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，认识产线装配工具和日常设备，学习正确使用工具。并在资深装配员的监督下，尝试使用各种产线日常设备。
●	在资深装配员指导下，参与车间 5S 管理。学习保持工位整洁有序，规范存放物料与工具。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，学习阅读作业指导书，并在资深装配员的监督下完成分配的装配任务。
●	在资深装配员的指导下，观摩测试工作，了解产品续测试环节涉及的步骤及造成残次品原因的装配原因。
●	记录所观摩到的装配过程、基础测试台操作、物料清点步骤，在实习期结束形成完整的实习报告。
About the team
作为亚马逊旗下一员，RIVR 致力于通过真实的末端配送场景开拓具身智能（Physical AI）的前沿应用。公司于 2024 年脱胎于苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich），专注于研发能够在楼梯、门禁通道和高低不平的城市路面等复杂非结构化环境中稳定运行的轮腿式机器人。我们深信，要实现真正的通用物理智能，必须立足于解决现实世界中的实际需求，让机器人在海量且真实的运营数据中持续进化。
自 2026 年 3 月加入亚马逊以来，我们在更大规模与更快节奏下继续推进这一愿景。结合定制机器人硬件、机载自主导航与云端协同控制能力，亚马逊旗下的 RIVR 正在构建下一代更安全、更可靠的最后一公里自主配送机器人。

Basic qualifications
●	机械制造、机电一体化、电子技术等相关专业的在校学生。
●	有一定的机械/电子装配动手经验（学校项目、实验或兼职经验均可），乐于学习精密装配技能。
●	具备基础的机械图纸认知能力，愿意学习提升
●	对自动化设备有学习兴趣，无需经验
●	具备在校学习的电路和机械基础理论知识
●	学习能力强，有动力快速掌握新的装配流程
●	工作细心负责，愿意遵循工作指导文件，保证工作质量
●	良好的团队协作能力，愿意服从工作安排
●	遵守安全标准，具备较强的安全意识

Preferred qualifications
●	在学校实验室或实习中有接触过测试台操作
●	对物料和库存管理有兴趣
●	对学习专业机器人测试台架操作有兴趣
●	持有或正在考取相关基础证书（如电工证）者优先
●	能适应快节奏的学习环境，对装配和测试的不同工作内容有好奇心

Amazon-10600886.title: Associate Solutions Architect Intern - Beijing, Beijing
Amazon-10600886.description:
●	毕业时间：2027年9月 - 2028年6月之间毕业的应届毕业生
●	实习入职日期：2027年6月及之前
●	实习时间：保证一周实习5天全职实习，至少持续4个月及以上
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you’ll help your customers successfully implement cloud technologies. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
Building relationships to understand our customers is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
You’ll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just want to be part of an industry movement; you’ll want to be leading it. As a Builder, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
这里是亚马逊云科技(AWS)解决方案架构师团队，如果你想指引并帮助客户使用最先进的云服务，如果你愿意以技术引领行业的发展，如果你喜欢充满激情的工作，我们期待你的加入！作为亚马逊云科技的解决方案架构师实习生，你将是备受客户信任的技术向导，通过技术为客户创造长远的价值。你将与公司遍布全球的产品、开发、技术支持、客户经理等团队通力合作，用广泛的云服务为客户提供最佳方案，用先进的云理念解决客户的难题。
这里有最丰富的技术方向供你选择。你可以投身生成式 AI 和智能体（Agentic AI）浪潮，打造能理解、会推理、可执行的 AI Agent，构建多智能体协作、AI 编程助手等前沿应用，帮助客户把大模型用到真实的业务场景里；也可以深入研究容器、微服务、DevOps，发展成数据分析专家；你可以搭建一款 Serverless 应用，或者制作一部自己的游戏；还可以专注物联网和边缘计算的方案设计与实现。
我们会发展技术深度与沟通技能兼备的人才，我们会培养面向客户需求定义技术方案的能力，我们会锻炼复杂场景下达成目标的意志。在这里，你既可以与全球顶尖企业碰撞思想，也可以与草根初创公司共同成长。
Key job responsibilities
成为AWS解决方案架构师实习生，你将：
●	响应客户云服务技术咨询，执行云计算方案原型开发。
●	参与生成式 AI 与 AI Agent 方案的设计、原型开发和落地，帮助客户用大模型和智能体技术实现业务创新。
●	为用户制定合理的上云方案，帮助用户开启云之旅。
●	拓展用户对云产品的理解，促进IT架构优化和技术转型。
●	与云产品和研发部门深度合作，根据客户的需求不断改进亚马逊云产品。
●	通过客户workshop、大型公开活动等方式传递云上最佳技术实践。
Amazon-10600886.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 2027年9月 - 2028年6月之间毕业的应届毕业生
- 研究生及以上学历
- 理工科背景以及计算机，人工智能，大数据，云计算等相关专业优先。
- 熟悉Linux、Windows操作系统，存储、网络、数据库等IT行业基础知识。
- 具备开发经验和能力。
- 具备快速学习及深度钻研能力。
- 关注细节，工作严谨，口头和书面表达沟通能力强。
- 熟练的英语听说读写技能。

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you’ll help your customers successfully implement cloud technologies. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
Building relationships to understand our customers is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
You’ll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just want to be part of an industry movement; you’ll want to be leading it. As a Builder, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

Amazon-10598511.title: Auto Industry Specialist, CMHK IVT
Amazon-10598511.description:
About Amazon Web Services Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit aws.amazon.com.
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
Amazon Web Services came to China in 2013, and has been relentlessly investing and expanding our infrastructure and business since then. Amazon Web Services launched its China (Beijing) Region (operated by Sinnet) in September 2016 and its China (Ningxia) Region (operated by NWCD) in December 2017. In 2019, Amazon Web Services added a new region in Hong Kong, making China the only country with three Amazon Web Services regions aside from the U.S. In 2022, Amazon Web Services launched Local Zone in Taipei.  Amazon Web Services has also established an AI lab in Shanghai and two IoT labs in Shenzhen and Taipei. The Amazon Web Services Partner Network has thousands of Partners in China. Amazon Web Services has supported over 10,000 local startups and has provided cloud skills training to over 700,000 talents. Amazon’s first two utility-scale renewable projects—a solar farm and a wind farm—are also generating clean energy to the country’s grid.
Our vision is to be the most trusted technology partner for the world's automotive companies as they go through the biggest transformation in their history. Three industry forces make this moment urgent. First, the rapid shift to software-defined vehicles (SDV), autonomous driving and connected mobility is changing how vehicles are designed, built, sold and operated. Second, generative AI and agentic AI are opening up a new generation of intelligent R&D, smart factories and predictive supply chains. Third, automakers are under intense pressure to cut costs, localize production and build resilience against geopolitical and tariff disruption.
You will be a trusted advisor to automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. You will help line-of-business (LoB) leaders, such as VPs of R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Digital, and reimagine their vehicle development, production systems and industrial data strategies with AWS. This is not an IT infrastructure role. You will work where cloud and AI meet automotive domain expertise.
The ideal candidate has a business development or consulting background in the automotive industry and a proven track record of engaging at the CxO/VP level. You should have a solid understanding of cloud and applied AI/GenAI, plus enough technical depth to work easily with technical architects. This role requires a strong passion for customers, comfort with ambiguity and a keen sense of ownership to deliver results.
You will own and drive the LoB pipeline across a portfolio of strategic automotive accounts. That work runs from finding and qualifying opportunities, through building the business case, to moving deals toward close. You will turn automotive business pain points into solutions built on AWS services and ISV/partner offerings. You will build relationships with LoB buyers, not just IT procurement, and work across sales, service and partner teams. You will also represent AWS at selected industry events and contribute to thought leadership content.
Key job responsibilities
•	Define and execute a strategic go-to-market (GTM) plan for automotive that aligns with AWS strategic direction and revenue targets. The plan covers market segmentation and sizing, industry solution priorities (SDV, ADAS/AD, connected vehicle, smart manufacturing, supply chain) and competitive positioning.
•	Identify, develop and realize business opportunities that create customer value and drive AWS AI/cloud revenue. Build a repeatable pipeline and speed up existing deals. Support account teams in structuring strategic agreements (for example, PPAs) and in complex contract negotiations, working with Legal and Compliance.
•	Serve as a strategic advisor to automotive executives at CxO and VP+ level, building long-term trusted relationships. Identify and engage key partners, including ISVs and system integrators, and build scalable joint solutions and co-sell motions.
•	Act as the expert on AWS capabilities for automotive use cases. Understand customers' technical requirements and pass customer signals and industry trends to AWS Product, Engineering and Service teams to influence roadmaps.
•	Find whitespace opportunities where AWS can lead innovation in the automotive ecosystem. Work with Sales on qualified opportunities, with a clear view of each customer's business drivers, stakeholders and urgency.
•	Create scalable mechanisms, engagement playbooks and industry solution frameworks so field teams can engage automotive customers consistently. Present business reviews to senior management on progress and roadblocks and keep pipeline data accurate in Salesforce and other internal systems. Handle a high volume of engagements in the fast-paced cloud computing market.
About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Amazon-10595092.title: B2B Seller Consultant, SSM AB CN2JP
Amazon-10595092.description:
Amazon is now  reinventing on behalf of the business customer and    focused on building  the largest and most innovative    Business-to-Business (B2B) marketplace  in the world, and we are    recruiting to make this vision a reality.
Amazon Business is  Amazon’s response to tackle this incredible    opportunity to address a  vast new market segment and customer base. We    are focused on building  solutions that enables the B2B customer to  find,   research, and buy  products and services from a vast selection,  across   multiple devices,  marketplaces and regions. Our customers  include   individual  professionals, small businesses to large  institutions (and   everything  in between). Our B2B customers have  different needs than the    traditional Amazon customer so we are  reinventing everything from how   we  display our selection, price our  products, and provide the right    customer experience.
Responsibilities:
Amazon  Business is  seeking a dynamic and motivated individual   contributor as  B2B Sales  Manager. This manager will be responsible for   recruiting and   launching businesses to sell products on Amazon.com and   our new B2B   marketplace. Amazon is making a strategic investment in  B2B  through  the  launch of Amazon Business. This is a great opportunity  to  get in  on the  ground floor and help shape the future!
The Sales Manager  will be  expected to drive a large pipeline of   high-value accounts,  while  executing sales strategies to secure deals   that will exceed  aggressive  account acquisition and revenue targets.
As a growing  organization,  Amazon Business is highly influential   across Amazon  customers, category  teams, and sellers. Amazon Business   combines the  selection, convenience  and value customers have come to   know and love  from Amazon, with new  features and unique benefits that   address the  needs of businesses.
- Identify,  qualify, and  engage with prospective sellers for the   Amazon Business  Marketplace  while creating a clear value proposition  of  selling to  business  customers on Amazon, along with the features  and  functionality.
- Meet or exceed quotas, revenue targets, and operational metrics.
- Build   strong communication channels at all levels of the   Seller’s   organization, set proper expectations, provide clear status     communications, and manage towards a growth plan.
- Analyze  the  business and conduct deep dive analysis; provide   routine  executive-level  reporting on the Seller’s current business and   future  opportunities.  Publish recommendations and action plans based  on   data.
- Implement  and track metrics for recording the success  and   quality of the sellers  in your territory. Use these metrics to  guide   your work and uncover  hidden areas of opportunity.
- Utilize  CRM tools such as  Salesforce.com to track all pertinent   account  information and sales  progress as well as forecast and   prioritize to  achieve quarterly goals.
- Prepare and deliver business reviews regarding progress and state of health for the respective territory.
- Develop   a thorough understanding of the e-commerce industry and   competitive   environment, including knowledge of competitive product   offerings.
- Assist internal partners to drive change, remove roadblocks, and close business.
- Manage   additional projects concurrently with managing daily   production   environment, such as competitive analysis, and sales   analysis as  needed.
- Advocate  on behalf of Sellers and other external  stakeholders   to influence  product roadmap, lead generation,  integration process, and   reporting  activities.

Amazon-10533846.title: Brand Specialist
Amazon-10533846.description:
About Amazon
Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
About the Role
Account Management- Brand Specialist
As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.
AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.
You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.
You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting business.
Key job responsibilities
• Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.
• Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.
• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.
• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data to improve vendor experience.
• Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.
• Conduct regular WBRs, MBRs with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and building action plans.
Amazon-10533846.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 2+ years of sales or account management experience
- 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

Preferred qualifications
- Experience analyzing key open issues and resolution metrics for each of the managed accounts
- Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

Amazon-10538315.title: Business Analyst, Amazon Global Logistics
Amazon-10538315.description:
Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) is seeking a data-driven Business Analyst to join the APAC Sales Intelligence & Business Development team. In this role, you will leverage data analytics, business intelligence tools, and cross-functional collaboration to generate actionable insights that guide operational decisions, sales performance, and strategic planning. You will serve as the subject matter expert on presenting data in an informative and actionable way, supporting leadership in making key business decisions through metrics design, reporting automation, and deep-dive analysis.
Key job responsibilities
As a Business Analyst on the AGL team, you will work with large-scale datasets across Amazon's data warehouse ecosystem to design, build, and maintain reporting solutions that enable self-service data consumption. You will collaborate closely with sales leaders, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex data into digestible insights, identify performance gaps, and recommend data-driven action plans.
**Data Analysis & Insights**
-   Gather business insights by mining data from complex data warehouses, making recommendations, and helping senior leaders make key business decisions
-   Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of structured and unstructured data to automate and optimize key processes
-   Perform deep-dive analysis on key business metrics (e.g., bookings, conversion, sales performance, seller behavior) and translate findings into actionable recommendations
-   Size opportunities, apply statistical testing methods, and build analytical models to address quantitative business problems
-   Proactively identify areas of opportunity for in-depth investigation and future program development
**Reporting & Dashboarding**
-   Design, develop, and maintain scaled, automated dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar) to support business needs
-   Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, and KPI tracking
-   Build data visualization reports and tools for self-service data consumption
-   Improve corporate reporting frameworks and ensure each report is accurate and timely
**Business Metrics & Measurement Systems**
-   Design and implement tangible business metrics, measurement systems that guide operations, projects, and program roadmaps
-   Update KPI metrics, monitor KPI performance, and support performance deep-dives
-   Build and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure, control, and benchmark business processes
**Automation & Technical Development**
-   Execute SQL queries and database operations to retrieve and manage data requirements
-   Use Python (e.g., pandas) to clean, transform, and format data for reporting and downstream use
-   Automate planning, deep-dive, and reporting models to increase efficiency
-   Generate complex queries to dive deep on process issues
**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
-   Collaborate with centralized Business Intelligence and Data Engineering teams to leverage existing data and build access to new data
-   Serve as the primary data reporting and analysis expert supporting business teams, following an intake and prioritization process
-   Communicate results to stakeholders effectively and facilitate data-driven decision making
-   Partner with sales, marketing, product, and operations teams to deliver insights that drive business growth
**Data Quality & Governance**
-   Perform thorough data validation to maintain accuracy, integrity, and consistency across all datasets
-   Analyze and validate data to ensure high data quality and reliable insights
-   Investigate data anomalies, understand root causes, and develop alternative measurement strategies

Amazon-10538976.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. We are looking for a dynamic, organized self-starter to join as a Senior Business Development Manager for our Amazon Global Store program in South Korea, focusing on CS/CX work stream.
The Amazon Global Store Senior Business Development Manager will manage key business inputs of Amazon Global Store and be a key driver of the Global Store engagement with internal Amazon and external teams, including: Global Mile, Cross-Border DEX, Finance, Product, Tech and Exports Marketing. As you are the key Point of Contact across multiple internal & external stakeholder teams, over indexing on Earns Trust, Dive Deep, Bias for Action and Ownership are important for success in this role. Additionally, you will need to flex your influencing and team-building skills for this position, as we work together to develop the more junior members of the team.
This person must have strong self-motivation and project management skills. This position will be key part of the Global Store expansion strategy in South Korea and have responsibilities towards reporting to leadership on key internal initiatives that grow top and bottom line. Having Korean language skill and/or local market knowledge is preferred.
In this role, your key responsibilities will be:
-Key internal stakeholder management and influence
-P&L ownership and management
-Store management, growth and expansion
-Work with CS team to improve customer shopping experience on our externalization stores.

Amazon-10557610.title: Business Ops Manager
Amazon-10557610.description:
The CMHK Field Tech Operations is a strategic advisor and operating role to the CMHK Area Tech Leaders. You will translate CMHK Tech strategy and business priorities into executable plans, scalable mechanisms, and measurable customer outcomes across Solutions Architecture, Customer Solutions Management, and strategic initiatives.
You will also own the area’s migration strategy and execution end to end, driving progress from opportunity identification through migration launch, modernization, and consumption realization with a large cross functional team across the Area. This is a cross-functional, hands-on role working closely with Tech Leaders, as well as Professional Services, Partners ..etc., and worldwide teams.
The ideal candidate will combine strategic judgement, analytical rigor, commercial awareness, and operational discipline to solve complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and improve execution across the Area. Success in this role requires the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Key job responsibilities
• Strategy and Planning: Support the Tech operating plan development, translating Area’s Tech strategy and business priorities into clear priorities, actions, and outcomes.
• Business Performance: Establish KPIs, lead business reviews, and provide decision oriented insights that improve performance, resource allocation, and execution.
• Sales and Tech Alignment: Align technical priorities and capacity with the Area business plan and identify gaps requiring leadership action.
• Migration and Modernization: Own the Area’s strategy and execution end to end, from opportunity identification and prioritization through migration, modernization, launch, consumption realization and drive execution across teams.
• Strategic Initiatives: Coordinate GenAI, customer adoption, and other Area Tech OP2 initiatives, recommending when to scale, redesign, simplify, or stop.
• Resource Planning: Provide data-backed recommendations on capacity, coverage, skills, and technical resource allocation.
• Customer Adoption: Track customer progression from technical engagement to production adoption and business outcomes, distinguishing activity from measurable impact.
• Global Alignment: Act as the operational link between CMHK and Global Tech Operations, adopt common standards, escalate systemic blockers, and share scalable best practices.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Influence, build alignment and drive execution across Sales, Services, Professional Services, Partners, technical teams, and worldwide organizations.
About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Are you passionate about driving international business growth through innovative, AI-powered solutions? Join our TBAM+ team within Amazon Global Selling, where you'll manage a portfolio of China-based sellers as they scale their presence in Amazon's Australia marketplace. The TBAM+ team is a dedicated group of Account Managers focused on CN2AU medium and small sellers, combining strategic account management and incubation with scaled, data-driven operations. This role sits at the intersection of cross-border e-commerce, data analytics, and relationship management — helping sellers unlock new growth opportunities while delivering exceptional customer experiences.
As an Account Manager II on the TBAM+ team, you will own a large portfolio of CN2AU sellers, serving as their trusted advisor in the Australia marketplace. This is a one-to-many (portfolio) management role: you'll prioritize across a book of sellers, segment them by potential, and scale your impact by combining strategic engagement for key accounts with efficient, standardized playbooks and AI tools for the broader portfolio. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, using data-driven insights to guide sellers from onboarding through scaling — making a measurable impact on international seller success.

Manage a large portfolio of CN2AU sellers in the Australia marketplace, balancing engagement for key potential accounts with scaled, standardized playbooks for the broader book of business — coaching China-based sellers to maximize their marketplace presence;
Leverage AI tools and internal analytics platforms to analyze seller performance data, sales trends, and marketplace metrics at scale, turning insights into actionable recommendations that drive selection growth, feature adoption, and profitability across your portfolio;
Partner with sellers to achieve data quality standards and performance benchmarks, ensuring optimal product listings and customer experiences through expert use of internal tools and AI-powered solutions;

We foster a collaborative environment where continuous learning and innovation drive success. Our members grow their expertise in marketplace dynamics, scaled portfolio management, and data analysis — building the future of international e-commerce by empowering sellers with the insights, tools, and support they need to grow sustainably.

• Drive cross-functional programs from scoping through execution, managing timelines and stakeholder alignment.
