Amazon-10596131.title: Developer Marketing Manager, Developer Marketing
Amazon-10596131.description:
The AWS China Mainland and Hong Kong (CMHK) Marketing team is looking for a Developer Marketing Manager who is equal parts content creator and community connector. You will be the person behind the camera, at the keyboard, and in the comments — producing developer-facing content that cuts through the noise on platforms where developers actually spend their time.
You will create and publish across formats — vlogs, technical blogs, short-form videos, social posts — with the creative instinct to make developers stop scrolling. If you've built your own following, run a personal tech channel, or know what it takes to grow an audience from scratch, this role is for you.
Beyond content, you will engage with third-party developer communities — tech media with community reach (CSDN, InfoQ, GeekPark), and influencer-led technical groups — to expand AWS's organic presence in the developer ecosystem. You will also work cross-functionally with product marketing, tech teams, PR, and business teams to align your content and community efforts with broader GTM goals.
Key job responsibilities
• Create and publish high-quality developer-facing content across social platforms: vlogs, technical blogs, demo videos, short-form videos, and social posts — with a consistent voice that resonates with developers and builders.
• Bring creative, thumb-stopping ideas to content and program design — you know what makes a developer click, watch, share, and come back.
• Build and maintain relationships with 3P developer communities — community-oriented tech media, influencer-owned technical groups, and open-source organizations — to amplify AWS's reach where developers already gather.
• Collaborate with product marketing, field marketing, tech teams, PR, and business teams to ensure content and community efforts ladder up to broader GTM goals.
• Support the planning and execution of developer programs — hackathons, workshops, competitions — with a focus on content capture and post-event storytelling.
• Track content performance, audience growth, and engagement metrics to continuously iterate on what works.
Amazon-10596131.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- A strong portfolio of self-produced content — blogs, videos, vlogs, or social posts — that demonstrates the ability to engage a technical audience. Personal influencer or creator experience is a strong plus.
- Creative instinct: able to come up with ideas that grab developer attention in a crowded feed — unexpected formats, compelling hooks, culturally relevant angles.
- Comfortable working cross-functionally with marketing, tech, and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication in both Chinese and English.
- Experience with cloud computing technologies, especially AI/ML services.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
- Experience as a content creator, tech influencer, or community leader with a demonstrable online presence.
- Proficiency with video editing tools, social media analytics, and content management workflows.

The Account Manager will partner with strategic sellers, sales and product team, to grow sellers’ businesses on Amazon worldwide including identifying opportunities to maximize selection, driving feature adoption, monitoring seller’s healthy growth, performance, product quality, as well as working with sellers to achieve our standard and deliver the best e-commerce experience for customer on Amazon. Work with strategic sellers to grow the selections to Amazon and their business with profit

Work with strategic sellers to drive the seller performance and product quality to ensure best customer experience
Drive business reviews with sellers and do analysis to understand sales trends and drivers and develop recommendations on how to grow the business

Show super strong competency in delivering result, bias for actions, dive deep, ownership, earn trust and customer obsession

- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights

Amazon-10576552.title: Finance Manager, Asia Global Selling Finance
Amazon-10576552.description:
More than 300 million customers shop in Amazon’s store, and every day, customers browse, purchase, and review products sold by third-party sellers right alongside products sold by Amazon. Since 2000, Amazon has offered this digital shelf space to individuals and companies of all sizes, helping them reach hundreds of millions of customers, build their brands, and grow their business. Fast-forward to the present day, and these third-party seller products account for more than half of all units sold in our store. The WW Amazon Global Selling team is responsible for recruiting 3P sellers and helping them grow their business on Amazon, either through their own logistic networks or leveraging Amazon's global fulfillment and customer service network. We place great focus on building a healthy Seller business which determines the future and potential of Amazon's 3P business.
WW Global Selling Finance is seeking a Finance Manager to support the China Global Selling business. Finance is critical to the success in our mission. We see the entire picture, and are a cornerstone to driving the right investments, maintaining controllership, and distilling down the right stories to push our business forward.
As a member of this team, you will leverage analytical, technical, and communication skills to drive worldwide projects, engineer ad-hoc financial analyses, support business planning, and implement ideas for process improvement. The ideal candidate will have a growth mindset, be comfortable with healthy respectful debate, and be skilled at earning trust across both finance and business teams. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the fastest growing divisions within Amazon.
Key job responsibilities
• Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models, interpret data, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders throughout Amazon. These decisions can have global impact.
• Educate business partners on financial and non-financial trade-offs and provides guidance and financial analysis for new projects and initiatives. You make thoughtful judgement calls in ambiguous environments where data may be scarce or difficult to procure.
• Identifies opportunities to resolve defects proactively. Improves, scales, or simplifies finance tools across teams and organizations.
Amazon-10576552.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 7+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field

Preferred qualifications
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MSAccess, Essbase or Cognos) and providing recommendations based on results of ad hoc analyses to management for strategic decision-making

Amazon-10529581.title: Global Partner Manager, LCSA, Large Client Sales, Ads
Amazon-10529581.description:
Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers and agencies. Our ad solutions, including video, display, device ads, audio and custom ads, leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage target audiences throughout their day. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a strong focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.
Amazon Ads is seeking an Account Executive to join our Acquisition team within our Large Customer Sales organization. This is an exciting opportunity to support our rapidly growing Streaming TV and Video business and will be focused on activating and growing net-new Advertisers. As an Account Executive working within a business development team, you will use your experience selling TV/Video and digital advertising solutions to advertisers and their Ad Agencies to successfully grow and scale advertising revenues. You will utilize your client-side and agency relationships within the advertising space, employ a consultative approach and have deep understanding of the TV and digital advertising landscape.
Successful candidates will be results-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, have the ability to quickly understand client objectives and tailor the positioning of Amazon Ads' branding solutions accordingly. Motivated to learn new technical skills, candidates pride themselves on operational excellence, including tracking inputs, sales progress and pipeline, as well as regularly reviewing their performance to improve their outreach, engagement, and deal rate. Strong candidates will be eager to learn and develop themselves, have experience in high-volume, transactional sales, and a hunger to uncover opportunities at scale and connect them with value-adding solutions.
Key job responsibilities
• The Account Executive generates advertising revenue via Ad agencies and advertisers directly, through objective led selling across video solutions and other brand-building advertising solutions.
• Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities, aligning them with our value-adding solutions
• Influence buying decisions to drive increased revenue with focus on new revenue streams.
• Establishes credible relationships with agencies and advertiser decision makers, in particular in the TV and Digital landscape.
• Map account strategies, aligning resources and uncovering which of our digital, audio, video and device products best serves an advertiser’s needs
Amazon-10529581.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience in building client and agency relationships
- Experience in Media Buying or Selling (Connected TV, TV, Video Products and Strategies)
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Thrive in fast paced dynamic environment, be adept at dealing with ambiguity and have good communication and presentation skills.
- Bachelor / Master’s degree or equivalent experience in the industry

Preferred qualifications
- Relationships within the media industry across publishers, clients and agencies

Amazon-3160637.title: Global Partner Manager, Sales, Amazon Ads
Amazon-3160637.description:
Amazon Advertising is dedicated to drive measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions, including sponsored ads, display, video, and custom ads, leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including selfservice, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses to build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more.
Key job responsibilities
Deliver the revenue goals through exploring the new business opportunities through identifying and creating new relationships with advertisers.
Understand Amazon's search and display advertising tools to help build relevant and effective advertising solutions for our advertisers.

Amazon-10426498.description:
The Accommodation Consultant (AC) will work directly with employees and senior leadership in providing accommodations. The AC will be the primary contact for the employee as they proceed through the accommodation process. This role will have exceptional communication and organizational skills, superior attention to detail, ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong analytical and critical thinking skills, along with the customer service focus that employees expect from Amazon.

- Perform accommodation reviews to ensure compliance and to support employee requests for accommodation in safe and productive assignments
- Serve as a subject matter expert on the accommodations process as well as state and federal disability laws.
- Coordinate the accommodation process and provide end-to-end case management
- Collaborate with Stakeholders to determine and finalize accommodation approval/denials
- Collaborate with leave of absence case managers
- Communicate the accommodation decision, disseminate the Job Accommodation Record (JAR) to the employee, and partner with appropriate stakeholder(s) for implementation
- Educate employees and HR on complicated aspects of the return to work, accommodation, and complex case processes
- Direct employees to the appropriate resource for answers
- Maintain a case load of up to 120 cases.
- Ability to discern when to escalate complex issues to the Sr. Accommodation Consultant
- Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
- Provide training for employees, managers, HR and others in DLS
- Adhere to internal SLAs and quality standards
- Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrators, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
- Participate in other activities and projects within the DLS program
- Maintain regular, reliable and timely attendance
- Perform other duties as assigned
- Ability to travel as appropriate (up to 25% of the time)

Amazon-10558473.title: Head of Customer Success, Selection & Brand Success, ESM
Amazon-10558473.description:
Amazon Global Selling is a key initiative to achieve our vision to offer customers Earth's largest selection. We provide businesses the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform worldwide. Each year, tens of thousands of businesses join our Marketplace in 10 countries, adding millions of new products.
Amazon's Asia Global Selling organization is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Customer Success to lead and scale our Strategic Account Management operations. This senior leader will own the end-to-end strategy for driving seller selection growth, selection success, promotion effectiveness, and brand success, while leading seller engagement, campaign optimization, seller profiling, and talent development across the organization. Reporting to senior leadership, s/he will be responsible for building high-performing teams, setting the strategic direction for seller success programs, and driving measurable business outcomes at scale.
The ideal candidate is a seasoned people leader with a strong track record of managing and developing teams, driving cross-functional programs, and delivering results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. S/he combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, leverages data to inform decisions, and has the ability to influence senior stakeholders across the organization. Experience in marketplace/e-commerce, seller/partner ecosystem management, or customer success at scale is highly preferred.
Key job responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Team Management
•	Lead, mentor, and develop a team of program managers and customer success professionals; set clear goals and drive a high-performance culture
•	Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for seller engagement and success programs, aligning with Asia Global Selling business priorities
•	Build organizational capability and talent bench strength through structured hiring, onboarding, and learning & development programs
Seller Engagement & Campaign Management
•	Own the planning, execution, and optimization of seller engagement campaigns and strategic marketing events end-to-end
•	Establish scalable frameworks for campaign creation, measurement, and continuous improvement; present campaign results and strategic recommendations to senior leadership
•	Drive innovation in how we engage, retain, and grow strategic sellers across the Asia region
•	Define and execute strategies to accelerate seller selection growth, improve selection success rates, optimize promotion effectiveness, and strengthen brand success metrics
Seller Profiling & Operational Excellence
•	Own the seller profiling workstream across the organization — define mechanisms, develop tools, and drive adoption of data-driven seller insights
•	Establish and optimize operational processes, workflows, and tooling to improve team efficiency and seller outcomes
•	Build and leverage dashboards and data infrastructure to identify opportunities, track performance, and inform strategic decisions
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
•	Partner with Account Management, Product, Marketing, and Business Intelligence teams to align on priorities and translate ambiguous requirements into executable plans
•	Serve as the key point of contact for customer success initiatives with senior leadership, ensuring alignment and visibility across the organization
•	Drive cross-team mechanisms for knowledge sharing, best practice dissemination, and holistic seller learning synthesis
Talent Development
•	Own the Strategic Account Manager training strategy — design learning modules, coordinate training sessions, and measure effectiveness
•	Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational rigor within the team

- 8+ years of experience in program/project management, customer success, account management, or related fields
- 5+ years of people management experience, including managing managers or cross-functional teams
- Proven track record of driving business results through strategic planning and operational execution
- Experience working with data analytics and business intelligence tools to drive decision-making
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Amazon-10584915.title: Japan Lead, Scaled Vendor Management, Retail Business Services (RBS)
Amazon-10584915.description:
About Amazon.com
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company  where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy  online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast  selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a  world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to  e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of  innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest  technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology  that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
About the Role
We are seeking a customer-obsessed senior leader to own the end-to-end strategy and execution for Amazon Japan's Managed Vendor Relations (MVR) program. This role serves as the Country Lead for JP MVR, managing a team of 5+managers — who in turn lead Account Managers — across VSP (vendor success program) and RVR (retail vendor recruitment). The candidate will set the long-term strategic direction, define the vision and tone for the organization, and drive business growth, vendor satisfaction, and operational excellence across a team of 30+ direct and indirect reports.
This leader will be responsible for shaping the multi-year roadmap for JP MVR, partnering with JP Retail category teams, RBS leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to unlock selection, merchandising, and revenue opportunities at scale. They will own end-to-end vendor performance — from recruitment and onboarding through joint business planning and execution — while managing complex stakeholder relationships. The ideal candidate thinks long-term, operates as a strategic business owner who can identify growth levers and translate them into scalable programs, and navigates ambiguity with confidence. They excel at influencing without authority, building high-performing leadership teams, and delivering exceptional customer and vendor outcomes across site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations, and marketing. They are at their best when setting organizational direction, developing leaders, and driving transformational results at country scale.
Key job responsibilities
1.	Lead a team of managers (managing Account Managers) across VSP (vendor success program) and RVR (retail vendor recruitment) — setting strategic direction and operating rhythm for 30+ direct and indirect reports.
2.	Own the long-term JP MVR strategy, identifying growth levers across the full vendor lifecycle to accelerate GMS and improve customer experience.
3.	Define and execute the multi-year JP MVR roadmap — driving selection, merchandising, and operational improvement at country scale.
4.	Partner with JP Retail, RBS leadership, and cross-functional teams to align on marketplace priorities and execute growth strategies across the vendor portfolio.
5.	Establish success metrics (GMS, NPS/CSAT, recruitment yield, operational health) and build mechanisms for accountability and continuous improvement across all programs.
6.	Develop scalable processes and guardrails to manage vendor complexity and drive consistency across workstreams.
7.	Serve as the strategic voice for JP MVR — influencing organizational strategy, shaping the vendor management roadmap, and representing JP MVR to senior leadership.
8.	Drive recruiting, talent development, and team culture — building a leadership bench, coaching managers, and raising the bar on performance and operational standards
About the team
The vision of RBS MVR team is “To unlock the full potential of every vendor on Amazon through an intelligent scaling engine, that transforms how we recruit, launch, and grow our partners to deliver unparalleled selection and value to customers worldwide".

-Experience with Doubleclick (XSM, DFP), AdJuster or Salesforce

Amazon-10547115.title: MDE-Automation , MDE Automation Team
Amazon-10547115.description:
We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply new advances in technology and to solve real-world problems that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet. As an Automation Engineer you will help develop and deploy our standard automation control system onto assembly automation machines at vendor and contract-manufacturer sites, from configuration & commissioning through a running production line. You will have the opportunity to work with a wide variety of technologies from AI models to robotics and custom automated manufacturing systems. You will own the quality of major deliverables end-to-end, working closely with multiple engineers and teams to execute them.
Key job responsibilities
As an Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for driving world class manufacturing software solutions to scale assembly automation globally. This will involve architecting, innovating software solutions for assembly processes, explore new technologies, implementing and scaling it globally. You will be driving the development working alongside team members from Asia pacific. You will be the main interface between the hardware, Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and Product Design Engineering teams; with local and Offshore Operations teams within Lab126 and our OEM partners.
A day in the life
• Design and develop scalable software architectures to program assembly automation solutions. This involves creating machine sequences (state machines, process flows) using AI assistants, validating AI-generated code and configuration (device drivers, hardware/connection config, production UI/HMI) to meet production quality standards.
• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot live hardware to optimize manufacturing performance
• Scale automation solutions working closely with Contract Manufacturers (CMs)
• Document software code, specifications for internal and external stakeholders.
• Train CM engineers to operate, extend, and troubleshoot the system independently.
• Create standardized reports for recurring issues and platform gaps back to the core platform and AI-tooling teams.
About the team
You will be working with highly skilled individuals with varying skills and backgrounds from China and US. Partner teams will look to you to solve complex issues using automation and come up with new ways to improve the overall product design to delight our customers.

Amazon-10535701.title: Manager I Ops, NOC Relay Ops
Amazon-10535701.description:
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers   and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the   world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new   technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like   Amazon Web Services).
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the   central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across   the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely   pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment   centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any   exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the   stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical   problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in   network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process   changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network   monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC   plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon   transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to   serve its customers on time.
Responsibilities of a NOC PM
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and cross-border program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making. This role is a part of the centralized Network Operations Centre (NOC) org part of Amazon India. This role is based in Dalian, China and will be required to work for Amazon Japan.
A Program Manager is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. They should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, they will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Program Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners. The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. They will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. They will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, outstanding analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way. This candidate is also expected to handle small sized operations teams (3-10 L3) to design and publish relevant reports to track overall program progress.
The incumbent will own the following -
1) They will be responsible for working with supply chain execution, transportation, FC, carriers and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
2) They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no-go decisions on various initiatives
3) Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
4) The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
5) They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.
6) They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed
Above all, we expect program managers to be single threaded owners for their initiatives.
Program Managers will be measured on the impact of their project. Depending on the project, clear financial or other impact goals will be set forth. It is the program manager's responsibility to ensure they drive the program towards achieving those goals.
What are we really looking for?
•	You should be very analytical and be able to justify your decisions and approaches with data
•	You should be able to deal with a high degree of ambiguity
•	You should be able to take a complex problem and break it down to smaller digestible chunks
•	You should be able to define a logical and step by step approach to achieving assigned goals
•	You should be comfortable with processes and process design/analysis
•	You should have the ability to influence without authority and do so by using data and facts
•	You should be able to deal with varied stakeholders and earn their trust
•	You are mature and able to function independently with limited guidance
•	You should be willing to travel 30% of the time
•	Languages proficiency (mandatory) – Japanese.
Key job responsibilities
The incumbent will own the following -
1) They will be responsible for working with supply chain execution, transportation, FC, carriers and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
2) They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no-go decisions on various initiatives
3) Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
4) The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
5) They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.
6) They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed
About the team
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

•	You should be able to define a logical and step by step approach to achieving assigned goals
•	You should be comfortable with processes and process design/analysis
•	You should have the ability to influence without authority and do so by using data and facts
•	You should be able to deal with varied stakeholders and earn their trust
•	You are mature and able to function independently with limited guidance

NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. About Amazon.com
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company  where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy  online. The world's brightest  technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology  that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
Key job responsibilities
About the Role
As a Manager, Account Management in Retail Business Services (RBS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on the strategy for managing Amazon vendors. RBS team is looking for a customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Vendor Consultant Managers responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all operational aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships. You will lead the team of Managers that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.
A day in the life
Responsibilities Include: · Managing a team of Managers, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed. Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience.  Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams. Manage end to end goal setting for team to align with organizational goals. Build relationships with stakeholders across the portfolio; proactively build joint business plan action items and act as a point of escalation for outstanding issues, questions, and concerns. Act as a thought leader in defining success criteria and understand business needs of Selling Partners in an ever-changing business environment. Contributes to and leads strategic plans and documents for the organization. Leads recruiting and hiring efforts across direct team and broader organization. Manage stakeholders needs and monitor complexity through efficient resource allocation. Drive/monitor stakeholder’s satisfaction survey results to analyze both positive and negative feedback trends. Establish improvement plans and mange expectations with Vendor Consultants as appropriate.

Amazon-10590945.title: Manager, Business Development, GSSC
Amazon-10590945.description:
Amazon Global Selling has been helping individuals and businesses increase sales and reach new customers around the globe. The Global Selling team in China is responsible for recruiting local businesses to sell on Amazon’s 21 overseas marketplaces, and supporting local Sellers’ success and growth on the Amazon. Our vision is to be the first choice for all types of Chinese business to go globally.
Amazon Global Selling is seeking an experienced, results-driven Carrier Business Development Manager to join the Global Seller Supply Chain (GSSC) central PMO team, leading a team of carrier managers focused on building and scaling logistics carrier networks for CN cross-border shipping to emerging marketplaces — including Latin America, Middle East, and other high-growth destinations. In this highly visible role, you will manage the full carrier lifecycle — from acquisition, onboarding, and rate negotiation to performance management and network expansion — while partnering closely with marketplace teams and global product teams to develop logistics solutions that improve seller experience and business outcomes.
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the logistic strategy for Amazon’s fastest-growing cross-border corridors, influence global product roadmaps, and build a high-performing team in an exciting and fast-paced business. The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, has deep carrier management or logistics BD experience, demonstrates a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, excels at navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments across cultures, and possesses best-in-class oral and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin Chinese.
Key job responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Carrier Managers; set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and build a culture of operational excellence and data-driven decision-making.
Own end-to-end carrier acquisition and network expansion for CN-to-emerging-marketplace carriers, identifying and onboarding carriers that meet Amazon’s requirements.
Drive carrier performance management across multiple dimensions, including delivery accuracy, tracking timeliness, cost-to-serve, and compliance; establish and maintain carrier scorecards and performance review cadences.
Lead rate negotiation and cost optimization initiatives with strategic carriers, balancing cost competitiveness with service quality and network resilience.
Partner closely with marketplace teams and global product teams to identify logistics gaps and co-develop shipping solutions that improve seller experience, reduce transit times, and support business growth in emerging markets.
Serve as a program leader for critical cross-border logistics initiatives, independently interfacing with and influencing marketplace leadership and global stakeholders to drive alignment and execution.
Own Operational Planning (3YP/OP1/OP2) for assigned domains, define and deliver key performance indicators, and proactively identify roadblocks and business opportunities.
Lead key planning cycles and reporting cadences for your assigned domain, including regular readouts up to VP level and contributions to SVP-level business reviews.
About the team
We are Amazon Global Selling (AGS) PMO team under the Global Seller Supply Chain (GSSC) organization. We collaborate with AGS business teams to identify key Seller needs and partner with global product teams to develop tools and solutions to improve Seller experience and sustainable growth.

Amazon-10582213.description:
Amazon is seeking an experienced candidate to develop and manage our growing global supply chain as part of Amazon Global Logistics. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being "Earth's most customer-centric company." Amazon Global Logistics supports and advances this mission by developing game-changing international capabilities and innovative supply chain strategies. We are a fast-paced, exciting, and growing organization in search of the planet's most talented supply chain professionals. Product Implementation & Go-to-Market: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to develop go-to-market strategies. Own end-to-end product launch implementation — from UAT coordination and SOP development through training and post-launch stabilization.
Operations Ownership & Customer Experience: Own operational execution for assigned workflows. Manage performance metrics (SLA compliance, quality, productivity) to drive customer experience improvements. Serve as the escalation point — triage issues, coordinate resolution, and minimize customer impact. Deliver performance reports to senior leadership.

Partner & Customer Enablement: Deliver domain-specific training and serve as the subject-matter expert at customer-facing events. Create technical content for regulatory updates and product changes.
Capacity Planning & Continuous Improvement: Own capacity planning, productivity metrics, and improvement initiatives through process redesign and automation.
People Management: Lead and develop high-performing teams; set clear expectations and build career pathways that support the team's evolution toward higher-value functions.

Amazon-10598458.title: Manager, Technical Program Management
Amazon-10598458.description:
Are you energized by leading teams that tackle complex, ambiguous technical challenges? Do you thrive when coordinating across multiple engineering and product teams to deliver programs that matter? We're looking for a Technical Program Management leader to manage a team of technical program managers and drive the execution of large-scale, cross-functional programs at Amazon. In this role, you'll define strategy, set goals, and guide your team through the full software development lifecycle — from planning through release. You'll shape how your team operates, establish workflows and service-level agreements, and build mechanisms that ensure consistent, measurable results. Your ability to navigate ambiguity, negotiate priorities, and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels will be key to your success.
Key job responsibilities
- Lead and manage a team of technical program managers, providing tactical and strategic direction while building a high-performing, inclusive team culture that empowers members to deliver independently.
- Drive execution of cross-functional technical programs from planning through release, defining scope, timelines, milestones, and success criteria across engineering, product, and operations teams.
- Identify and mitigate program risks, manage complex escalations, and make informed trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term strategic goals.
- Build and scale audit mechanisms, metrics, and reporting to track team progress, operational performance, and customer outcomes — communicating results clearly to leadership and key stakeholders.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and processes where appropriate to improve program efficiency, while establishing process improvements that reduce repeated work and simplify delivery.
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program status updates and preparing a narrative for an upcoming leadership review. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with engineers and product managers, unblocking a cross-team dependency and aligning on revised milestones. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report, coaching them through a stakeholder challenge and discussing their career development goals. Later, you collaborate with partner teams to negotiate resource priorities for the quarter ahead, then close out the day refining your team's operational metrics dashboard.
About the team
Our team is focused on delivering technical programs that have a meaningful impact on customers and the broader Amazon ecosystem. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers partner closely with engineering, product, and science teams to solve complex problems at scale. We are building toward a future where our programs run with greater efficiency and clarity, and we are looking for a leader who is excited to shape that vision. If you want to grow an inclusive team, drive operational improvements, and influence how Amazon delivers for customers, this is the role for you.

Amazon-10594268.title: NW Deployment Build Lead, Global Network Delivery
Amazon-10594268.description:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Services team provides comprehensive technical support throughout the design, planning, delivery, and operation of Amazon Web Services infrastructure. We support data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure the customers of Amazon Web Services have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations technical support managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across Amazon and our operating partners to help Amazon Web Services deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for the customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Project Lead to join our growing team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The candidate will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to develop innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.
The position responsibilities will include scaling support of several data center locations and be responsible for day to day assistance with capacity management. The Network Project Lead will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers, Network Deployment Planning team, infrastructure supply chain & procurement and network engineering team.
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.
This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.
In addition, this role may require international travels to support other cluster’s projects.
Key job responsibilities
1. Strategic Planning & Design Management
Contribute in developing comprehensive 6-8 months network implementation roadmaps aligned with AWS DC expansion targets
Create and optimize network position layouts and rack placement strategies for data centre floor space utilization
Review and contribute to High-Level Design (HLD) documentation
Coordinate with engineering teams to validate technical requirements and design specifications
Develop capacity planning models to ensure infrastructure scalability
Create standardized planning templates and methodologies for network implementations
2. Project & Resource Management
Lead end-to-end project planning for multiple concurrent network implementation initiatives
Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, milestones, and dependencies
Manage project scope, and quality parameters
Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies
Improvise and optimize planning by incorporating lessons learnt of latest deployed projects, iteratively.
Coordinate across cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project deliverables
Track and report weekly project progress and/or otherwise informed to key stakeholders
3. Supply Chain & Inventory Planning
Develop project inventory forecasts and requirements
Optimize developed counts by utilizing prior surplus spares.
Coordinate with procurement teams for strategic resource acquisition
Manage vendor relationships and delivery schedules
Establish and stick to procurement timelines aligned with project schedules
4. Program Governance & Process Excellence
Establish and maintain project management frameworks and best practices
Develop sustainable and repeatable planning processes
Create and maintain project documentation and reporting standards
Drive continuous improvement initiatives in planning methodologies
Build and maintain stakeholder communication channels
Coordinate with regional teams for standardized planning approaches and optimized lesson learnt based iterative optimized planning.
About the team
About Amazon Web Services
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Web Services values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Web Services?
Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Amazon Web Services pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust Amazon Web Services’ robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Amazon Web Services values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Coordinate with procurement teams for strategic resource acquisition
Manage vendor relationships and delivery schedules

Establish and maintain project management frameworks and best practices

Amazon-10493753.title: Operations Specialist, Retail Origin Ops
Amazon-10493753.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.
Amazon's Retail Origin Operations team is at the frontline of our global supply chain — overseeing freight movement across 120+ origin ports to 70+ destination ports, serving marketplaces in the US, EU, JP, CA, MX, AU, SG, TR, and MENA regions. As cross-border trade volume grows and business complexity increases, we are seeking an Operations Specialist to help manage logistics service provider (LSP) performance and ensure the seamless execution of retail direct import bookings from origin to destinations.
This role sits within the Global Logistics organization. We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in international freight operations, proven ability to manage LSPs and carriers through data-driven mechanisms, and a continuous improvement mindset. You will operate across ocean, LCL, rail, and air modes, working with partners including Origin Cargo Management service providers, NVOCCs, and LCL service providers. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of outcomes, and brings both analytical rigor and collaborative energy to everything they do.
Key job responsibilities
As an Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for managing retail booking processing and logistic service provider management at origin including:
1. Daily Operations & Exception Management: Execute assigned tasks per SOPs, resolve exceptions within SLA, and apply sound judgment when no existing procedure applies.
2.LSP Performance Management: Build mechanisms to track and improve logistics service provider performance — optimize KPIs, conduct root cause analysis, and own corrective actions through to resolution.
3. Carrier & Partner Collaboration: Work directly with origin LSPs and internal supportive functions to resolve operational issues and protect the experience of retail selling partners and internal stakeholders.
4. Risk & Compliance Handling: Assess compliance risks, surface roadblocks early, and escalate with clarity — particularly in regulatory or time-sensitive shipment scenarios.
5. Process Standardization & Kaizen: Drive standardization and Kaizen initiatives across carrier and LSP networks to improve logistics quality and reduce cost at scale.
6. Cross-Functional Process Improvement: Serve as a process subject matter expert, partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders to design and implement operational improvements across the supply chain.
7. New Initiative Support: Contribute to strategic programs and business launches, advancing operational excellence goals across speed, cost, and service quality as team scope expands.

Amazon-10576521.title: Partner Solutions Manager, Partner Solutions
Amazon-10576521.description:
Amazon Ads builds the technology connections between our advertising platform — the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — and the agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, and systems integrators that build on them. As a Partner Solutions Manager (PSM), you own the production life of these partner integrations: you keep them healthy, current, and performing in market, and you grow the revenue they generate over time.
Once an integration is live, you own its operational trajectory — production support, migrations, deprecations, and ongoing technical health. You are the technical owner partners rely on to keep a shipped integration running as the platform evolves, to drive migrations to completion, and to resolve production issues before they affect advertiser adoption or revenue. You handle complex, ambiguous operational problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, make pragmatic trade-offs between short- and long-term fixes, and escalate with sound judgment to clear blockers.
You coordinate across Partner Development, Amazon Ads product, and engineering teams to resolve recurring production issues and translate persistent partner friction into product feedback. You communicate clearly in writing and in technical reviews, and you are trusted to represent production health and risk to senior stakeholders. Success is measured in operational outcomes — sustained post-launch adoption, migration completion, time-to-resolution on production issues, and the revenue retained and grown across the integrations you own.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the production health of a portfolio of live partner integrations across the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — keeping them stable, performing, and current as the platform evolves.
- Resolve production issues end to end, from diagnosis to resolution, managing time-to-resolution and preventing recurrence.
- Plan and drive migrations and deprecations to completion, keeping integrations on supported patterns with no disruption to live traffic.
- Grow the revenue the integrations you own generate, acting on optimization and expansion opportunities within live implementations.
- Run the operational cadence with each partner's engineering team — health reviews, change management, release coordination — against clear reliability and adoption targets.
- Coordinate across Partner Development, Amazon Ads product, and engineering to unblock production issues and drive cross-team fixes to closure.
- Translate recurring partner friction into prioritized, evidence-backed product feedback.
- Make pragmatic short- vs. long-term trade-offs, escalating with sound judgment to clear blockers.
- Represent production health and risk to senior stakeholders through clear written narratives and technical reviews.
- Protect proactive capacity, holding reactive load within target so most time goes to durable health, migration, and revenue work.
A day in the life
Customers: partners whose integrations are live — agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, SIs, ERPs, Japan — working directly with their engineering teams; advertisers are the end beneficiaries.
Internal stakeholders: Amazon Ads Product & Engineering (Ads API, DSP, AMC, Stream), PDMs, Solutions Architects, pod manager and peer PTMs.
Problems solved: keeps live integrations stable as the platform evolves; drives migrations off deprecated patterns without disrupting traffic; resolves production issues before they stall adoption; turns recurring friction into product feedback; grows revenue from live implementations.
Daily: monitor portfolio health, run partner technical cadences, drive issue resolution and migrations, escalate defects, report production health.
About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.
Amazon-10576521.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience analyzing and troubleshooting RESTful web API calls, or experience in development or technical support
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Experience writing technical documents, project plans and progress reports to leadership and to stakeholders
- 3+ years of technical work experience, or Bachelor's degree in an advanced technical program
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role supporting software or API-based product integrations.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver products and projects on tight deadlines
- Experience in production, monitoring and metrics reporting
- - Experience operating or supporting AI/GenAI-enabled integrations — e.g., LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven reporting — in production.
- - Experience using AI tools to accelerate operational work (issue triage, diagnostics, documentation).
- - Experience supporting enterprise partners such as agency holding companies, CDPs, systems integrators, or third-party ad servers.
- - Familiarity with privacy-safe data patterns (clean rooms, 1P data).

Amazon-10565194.title: Principal Product Manager, Amazon Global Selling - PMO
Amazon-10565194.description:
Amazon Global Selling (AGS) helps selling partners reach customers around the globe. Today, more than 50% of Amazon's total unit sales come from third-party selection. The Global Selling team in China recruits local businesses to sell on Amazon's worldwide marketplaces and supports their growth and success. Our vision is to be the first choice for Chinese businesses going global. The AGS PMO team partners with Amazon's global teams to identify new opportunities and drive initiatives from design through launch and post-launch management.
We are seeking a data-driven Principal Product Manager in Shanghai to own the Brand Owner (BO) experience for China-based sellers, ensuring brands can grow and stay protected across Amazon's worldwide marketplaces, with a focus on BO sustainability and seller experience in high-stakes brand protection scenarios. The role works with stakeholder teams worldwide across functions. The ideal candidate thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment, and brings strong product/program management and communication skills.
Key job responsibilities
- Drive measurable impact on Brand Owner (BO) experience for China-based sellers across Amazon's worldwide marketplaces.
- Define seller experience standards for critical BO lifecycle use cases, such as brand merge and consolidation, brand ownership transfer, and cross-marketplace brand ownership.
- Develop mechanisms that surface China-based BO interdependencies and defects; drive product strategy and roadmap with worldwide partner teams, and own escalation paths through root-cause closure.
- Establish strong relationships with China and worldwide stakeholders to partner on shared goals and improvement roadmaps that minimize business disruption for sellers and Amazon.

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development, and/or technology experience

The position will be a key driver who can drive the data-driven services adoption of internet companies, traditional Enterprise, Startups, Developer communities’ IT environment. • Drive and lead new service launch programs to strengthen AWS thought leadership and technology awareness
• Developing marketing tools and campaign assets to attract new prospect and customers to generate product demands and marketing leads
• Build and strengthen the influencers’ community to generate businesses in the Enterprise, Startups, and Developer communities.
• Work closely with AWS service teams, Platform BD, PR, and other marketing managers to ensure the AWS message is reaching a broad audience via events, seminars, webinars, and other GTM activities.

• Co-work with key persons in the appropriate partners to make new IT trend.

Amazon-10477525.title: Product Sourcing Leader, Amazon Private Brands Global Sourcing
Amazon-10477525.description:
Do you have a passion for making and bringing great products to customers around the world? Do you want to build a business from the ground up? Do you have proven records of exceptional communication, project management skills, and the ability to multi-task and thrive in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy leading a team and coaching talents to deliver high impact business results as a people manager?  If yes, you should consider being a Product Sourcing Leader for Global Sourcing of Amazon Private Brands.
The APB Global Sourcing team is looking for customer-obsessed and self-driven individuals to lead supplier life cycle management and drive on-going business growth for Hardlines Private Brands business. The role will lead a talented team of sourcing managers to drive the global sourcing process from A to Z including new product development, product sourcing, vendor relationship management, cost negotiation, and business P&L management. You will build a global network to collaborate with international stakeholders from every function across Amazon Private Brands organization, including Business Management, Product Development, Supply Chain and Operation. Notably, you will also partner with APB Technology and Intelligence team to co-develop technical solutions and automate sourcing processes with the most advanced AI models in the world.
The candidate must have strong business acumen, strategic agility and a knack for identifying opportunities to design / implement long-term solutions. He or she must be capable of driving business impact and delivering results while dealing with ambiguity. A successful candidate will thrive in a highly collaborative, analytical, creative, and fast-paced environment.  The ideal candidate is experienced in working in a global team dealing with multi-stakeholders and diversified cultures, as well as willing to lead the team with empathy and develop talents to grow.
Key job responsibilities
·  Lead a team of product sourcing managers to drive business growth and profitability in an extensive range of Hardlines categories (i.e. Sports, Outdoors, Furniture, Lawn & Garden, Toys).
· Hire and develop the team with continuous coaching. Provide regular, actionable feedback to others that could improve their performance and unleash their potential. Support people's growth to achieve their career development goals.
· Partner with Global Product Development Managers, Regional Business Managers, Supply Chain, Quality, and other stakeholder teams to develop global sourcing and supply chain strategies , launching and managing products globally.
· Identify and realize business optimization opportunities and drive sourcing excellence leveraging global industry knowledge, vendor negotiation, resourcing and cost benchmarking.
· Drive for continual improvement and innovation across our sourcing activities, including vendor management, cost improvement, portfolio optimization and global supply chain efficiency.
· Collaborate with APB Technology team to develop tools and automate processes, elevating operation efficiency for vendors and sourcing team.
· Write professional business documents to provide leadership updates and lead strategic initiatives for stakeholders’ alignment.
About the team
Amazon Private Brand Global Sourcing team partners with suppliers capable of producing and shipping high-quality products globally, with a focus on driving profitable and sustainable business growth.

Amazon-10560140.title: Program Manager , Amazon Global Logistics
Amazon-10560140.description:
Amazon.com is seeking qualified candidates to join our Cross Border Exports Logistics team. Amazon.com reaches customers around the globe on all seven continents, and are in need of individuals who want to help ensure a fast cost effective solution to delivering packages to every far reach of the world. Do you obsess over how to improve processes to deliver a superior customer experience? Do the words “that can’t be done”, drive you to find a solution for how “that can be done”? Do you desire a career that will focus on how to globalize the B2C delivery service and set the new standard for the balance of the industry to envy? Do you thrive off of detailed data analysis to develop optimized processes and drive continuous improvement of those processes? If these characteristics describe you, then come join the Amazon.com Cross Border Exports team and help make the world smaller…one package at a time
The AGL team is looking for a strong candidate for the role of Program Manager- Cross Border Carrier Management. In this role the successful candidate will understand Amazons Fulfillment Network and will develop optimized processes to handle exports shipments to connected countries via ground/air shipping options. They will develop a process path to enable a cost effective fast delivery service to our customers in neighboring countries clearing Customs and delivering through the last mile. The successful candidate will thrive off waking up daily and determining how well we performed to our goals, and how we satisfied our customers today. Knowledge of transportation operations across LTL, FTL, customs and last mile is a key strength for the ideal candidate. Functional knowledge of data an analysis tools, standard deviation fundamentals and graphical data presentation models to highlight wins and misses will be integral to this role. A successful candidate will be able to show proven results in developing action plans as well as improvements implemented as a result of those plans. Additionally a successful candidate will be able to display strength influencing cross functional teams to take action on the data, as well as developing action items to improve results over the short and long term.
Amazon-10560140.requirements:
Basic qualifications

Amazon-10433854.title: Responsible Sourcing Manager,  Amazon Private Brands, Global Sourcing, Amazon Private Brands
Amazon-10433854.description:
Amazon Private Brands is looking for a Social Responsibility Manager to implement responsible sourcing programs, prevent & remediate risks and improve social responsibilities performance with global suppliers, including managing implementation of new initiatives. Amazon is committed to ensuring that all Private Brands products are produced in a way that respects and protects the rights of workers across our supply chain, and to lead by example by upholding and enforcing Amazon's Supply Chain Standard against our own brands. This is a global role that will work closely with Sourcing, Sustainability and Social Responsibility team.
Key job responsibilities
1. Manage the Social Responsibility (SR) audit workflow ensuring all active suppliers under Softlines Private Brands (SPB) are qualified for production. Resolve open issues with suppliers, escalate egregious issues to the business owners, and invent mechanisms to improve efficiency of our SR audits.
2. Vet, track, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures for day to day SR execution (audit scheduling and management, corrective action planning and remediation), including simplifying processes and eliminating process gaps (e.g., mismatched supplier data between Private Brands and Social Responsibility systems).
3. Identify potential SR risks with global suppliers from historical audit results and the consolidated SR performance scoring system. Work with central Amazon SR team to implement supplier engagement programs with selected SPB sites and track the SR performance improvement to evaluate program effectiveness.
4. Build, run, and maintain connection mechanisms with sourcing managers, APB Sustainability, and Amazon Social Responsibility team.
About the team
Amazon Private Brands’ (APB) vision is to make every day better with the most trusted products on the planet. We will achieve this by building a cohesive set of products that deliver incremental value to Amazon and fill selection gaps (in assortment, quality, price, convenience or sustainability) for customers. We partner with global suppliers, applying their insights when developing our product assortment strategy, whilst raising the bar on sustainable and responsible sourcing practices.

Amazon-10433854.full_text:
Amazon Private Brands is looking for a Social Responsibility Manager to implement responsible sourcing programs, prevent & remediate risks and improve social responsibilities performance with global suppliers, including managing implementation of new initiatives. Amazon is committed to ensuring that all Private Brands products are produced in a way that respects and protects the rights of workers across our supply chain, and to lead by example by upholding and enforcing Amazon's Supply Chain Standard against our own brands. This is a global role that will work closely with Sourcing, Sustainability and Social Responsibility team.
Key job responsibilities
1. Manage the Social Responsibility (SR) audit workflow ensuring all active suppliers under Softlines Private Brands (SPB) are qualified for production. Resolve open issues with suppliers, escalate egregious issues to the business owners, and invent mechanisms to improve efficiency of our SR audits.
2. Vet, track, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures for day to day SR execution (audit scheduling and management, corrective action planning and remediation), including simplifying processes and eliminating process gaps (e.g., mismatched supplier data between Private Brands and Social Responsibility systems).
3. Identify potential SR risks with global suppliers from historical audit results and the consolidated SR performance scoring system. Work with central Amazon SR team to implement supplier engagement programs with selected SPB sites and track the SR performance improvement to evaluate program effectiveness.
4. Build, run, and maintain connection mechanisms with sourcing managers, APB Sustainability, and Amazon Social Responsibility team.
About the team
Amazon Private Brands’ (APB) vision is to make every day better with the most trusted products on the planet. We will achieve this by building a cohesive set of products that deliver incremental value to Amazon and fill selection gaps (in assortment, quality, price, convenience or sustainability) for customers. We partner with global suppliers, applying their insights when developing our product assortment strategy, whilst raising the bar on sustainable and responsible sourcing practices.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience interacting with local food safety regulators

Preferred qualifications

- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel

Amazon-10605661.title: Sales / Account Manager, TSR NA, TSR NA
Amazon-10605661.description:
Amazon is looking for a smart and ambitious Seller Consultant to join its China team. The objective of the Sales consultant is to deliver new business growth and maximize revenue generation across Amazon's suite of products for merchants. Recruiting and launching sellers on Amazon's global marketplaces. You will analyze traffic and sales data to identify opportunities to help sellers succeed on the marketplaces.
Your superior communication, organizational and technical skills will enable you to operate in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, where you will have the autonomy to take full control and responsibility for achieving our business objectives.
Specific Responsibilities include:
Identify, recruit and support Sellers of various types (SMEs to large enterprise) to execute on business growth plans.
Develop a category recruitment strategy by analyzing the competitive landscape and defining new products' value proposition.
Review and monitor performance and sales of Amazon's partners in order to provide them with consulting advice to grow their business.
Feedback to other teams within Amazon worldwide lessons learned during project implementation and post-live support phases.
Coordinate and lead project with cross function teams and deliver result with stakeholders
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
1. Sales Execution & Seller Conversion
Receive qualified leads and drive end-to-end sales conversion. Identify key decision-makers within target companies, deliver tailored pitches based on category and seller profile, build trusted relationships with stakeholders across multiple business functions, and convert high-quality brand owners to launch and sell on the platform.
2. New Seller Onboarding & Activation
Guide newly launched sellers through their critical first 90 days on the platform. Help sellers optimize their product listings, build compelling content, generate early customer reviews, activate advertising and run promotional campaigns to build initial sales momentum and establish a strong market entry.
3. Category Knowledge & Region Development
Develop strong knowledge of relevant product categories to deliver informed and credible seller conversations. Stay current on category trends, competitive landscape and seasonal dynamics. Share learning with the broader team and contribute to building reusable regional knowledge and best practice to develop sellers in certain cities.
4. Relationship Management & Account Growth
Build and maintain long-term relationships with a portfolio of brand owners throughout their lifecycle on the platform. Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, coordinating engagement across procurement, e-commerce, marketing and executive contacts within the seller's organization. Drive seller satisfaction and long-term retention.

Amazon-10606796.title: Seller Community Specialist, SSG-Seller-Community
Amazon-10606796.description:
Seller Community is a key lever for managing regional sellers on Amazon's global marketplaces, with a focus on the core 100~200 sellers in each region. The Seller Community Specialist owns the operation of the local Amazon official Seller Community, helping local sellers succeed on Amazon.
As AI reshapes how sellers are served, this role will use AI to scale this model: going deep with core sellers while serving a growing regional seller base with consistent service quality. AI also helps close the loop on seller feedback (VOS): insights are captured from day-to-day service, routed to Amazon product and policy teams, and the outcomes are brought back to sellers.
Day to day, the Specialist resolves issues for key sellers, reviews and releases AI-assisted outputs with sound judgment, builds relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and continuously uses AI to iterate on the team's tools so its capacity scales over time.
Key job responsibilities
Seller Management: Maintain deep, ongoing relationships with the core  sellers in each region, serving as their key point of contact and account manager in local regional to help them succeed on Amazon; run bi-monthly or quarterly offline events to connect with local sellers face to face.
AI-enabled Service Delivery: Use AI-assisted tools to triage and draft responses to seller inquiries and tickets at scale, applying judgment on what to release directly vs. escalate for deeper handling, and following issues through to resolution; continuously use AI to improve workflows and the AI tools themselves, enabling the AM-to-seller ratio to scale.
VOS (Voice of Seller): Leverage the trust built with sellers to systematically collect their feedback; aggregate insights from day-to-day service by impact, route them to the right internal teams (e.g. Central CSM) for product and policy action, and close the loop by relaying outcomes back to sellers.
Cross-functional Partnership: Partner with AI team/tooling owners, Marketing, Central Ops and adjacent seller-management teams to execute Seller Community programs consistently.
