Amazon-10600782.title: Seller Consultant, JP Targeted Recruitment Team
Amazon-10600782.description:
Amazon Global Selling is seeking a Seller Consultant to join the Japan Targeted Recruitment (TR) team within NSR, based in Qingdao. The TR team takes a proactive, research-driven approach to identify, engage, and onboard high-quality Chinese sellers with strong product-market fit for the Japanese marketplace — one of Amazon's fastest-growing cross-border destinations.
As a Seller Consultant, you will own a portfolio of assigned seller relationships and deliver measurable business outcomes across the full seller lifecycle — from prospecting and consultative engagement to launch execution and post-launch growth. You will build expertise in JP market dynamics, use data and industry intelligence to execute the team's recruitment strategy, and work with cross-functional teams to resolve barriers to seller success.
This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and follow through on a defined plan. You will develop working knowledge of JP seller recruitment, apply the team's playbooks in your daily work, and contribute feedback to improve recruitment quality and seller productivity.
Key job responsibilities
- Build category knowledge through industry research (supply chain, manufacturing clusters, pricing, seasonal trends), and execute category-level recruitment plans based on JP marketplace gaps and demand signals.
- Build a high-quality seller pipeline through industry cluster mapping, trade shows, factory visits, and cross-marketplace analysis; apply and adapt segment-specific pitch content for different seller types.
- Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for your assigned sellers and drive seller success.
- Provide data-driven post-launch consulting to drive seller tiering-up, deliver selection guidance, and drive cross-launch from NA/EU into JP.
- Surface gaps and support new initiatives (e.g., cluster engagement program); contribute to cross-functional projects by owning assigned workstreams and documenting repeatable processes.
- Work with cross-functional teams on GTM execution and seller logistics optimization; support Amazon's presence at industry events.
A day in the life
Your week combines desk research, seller conversations, and time in the field. You might start by working through marketplace data to find where JP demand is unmet and which Chinese manufacturing clusters could fill the gap, then turn that analysis into a target list and a pitch tailored to that segment. Mornings often go to seller calls — walking a factory owner through what selling on Amazon Japan actually involves, or helping an existing seller read their post-launch performance data and decide which products to expand next.
Several times a quarter you will be on the road: visiting factories in a target cluster, working a trade show booth, or supporting a closed-door seller event. Back at your desk, you will move your pipeline forward in CRM, unblock onboarding issues with Compliance, Logistics, and Account Management partners, and write up what worked so the rest of the team can reuse it. No two weeks look the same, and you will have a clear view of how your pipeline is converting into launches and GMS.
About the team
Our team helps Chinese sellers succeed on Amazon Japan through hands-on consultative support and strategic guidance. We work in a collaborative, inclusive environment where new ideas are encouraged and every team member shapes how we serve our sellers.
We are focused on building scalable processes and strengthening seller relationships for the long term. If you are curious, motivated, and want to deepen your craft in sales and account management, this is a team where your work has visible impact on the business.

Amazon-10557427.description:
The mission of Amazon Global Selling (AGS) is to enable vast global selection  on Amazon's WW Stores through recruiting and supporting quality and  compliant Sellers from anywhere around the world.
Today, CN Global Selling (CNGS) supports millions of China Sellers for their success on up to 21 Amazon worldwide marketplaces including US, CA, EU, JP, AU, IN etc.
Your and your team's responsibilities revolve around three main areas: driving analytical insights, developing business plans, and working collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
I. Analytical Insights:
-Conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover key success drivers and obstacles, focusing on both Seller and Sales behavior.
-Share data-driven insights with stakeholders from China and international teams.
II. Business Plan Development:
-Develop China business plans to drive Seller success from the ground up (Cold Start).
-Identify opportunities for team efficiency improvement and Seller Experience enhancement.
III. Cross-Functional Collaboration:
-Work closely with the China Account Manager team, PMO team, Marketplace partners, and global central functions, among others.
-Thrive in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment, demonstrating strong analytical, program management, communication skills, and customer focus.
-Be innovative and excel in execution.
If you are passionate about working in a fast-paced, innovative environment, willing to embrace challenges, make history, and have fun, please apply for this position!
Key job responsibilities
Your daily responsibilities include but not limited to :
1. Strategy and Execution:
-Own and develop New Seller recruiting/success strategy and execution plan within the New Seller Recruitment Organization.
-Collaborate with internal (Sales team, Marketing, central PM teams) and external (global product, marketplace teams) stakeholders to drive Seller experience improvement and growth success.
3. Monitoring and Goal Setting:
-Monitor Seller registration to on-boarding experience and efficiency.
-Share goals with global and local PMO teams to enhance the experience and throughput.
4. Operational Processes:
-Build, monitor, and create operational processes and mechanisms that support global selling, new seller recruitment, and seller success.
-Partner with the China operations team to implement processes that benefit Account Manager team's efficiency, process adherence, and more.
-Collaborate with the Central Global team to influence changes for improved operational efficiency and resource allocation strategy.
-Land global initiatives into local operational processes.
5.Business Reviews and Strategy Planning:
-Drive regular business reviews with stakeholders.
-Contribute to strategy planning.

Amazon-10596130.title: Senior Developer Marketing Manager, Developer Marketing
Amazon-10596130.description:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) China and Hongkong Marketing team is looking for a Senior Developer Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end planning, execution, and amplification of developer marketing programs that drive awareness, adoption, and usage of AWS services across developer and builder audiences.
You will set the strategy and lead a team to design and run hackathons, competitions, hands-on workshops, and developer festivals — from problem statement design and platform setup all the way through promotion and post-event engagement. You won't just plan marketing tactics — you'll roll up your sleeves and build demo applications on AWS services yourself, so you can speak to developers as a peer, not just a marketer.
Beyond 1P programs, you will cultivate relationships with third-party developer communities — including open-source communities, community-oriented tech media (e.g., CSDN, InfoQ, GeekPark), and influencer-owned technical communities — to extend AWS's presence where developers already gather.
You will also lead to create compelling developer-facing content (blogs, vlogs, short-form videos, social posts) and bring creative energy to everything you do — designing programs that surprise, engage, and resonate with a developer audience that is notoriously hard to impress.
Key job responsibilities
•	Define the developer marketing strategy for Greater China and drive end-to-end delivery of programs: scoping, planning, cross-functional coordination, execution, promotion, and post-program analysis.
•	Set the bar for technical depth — design hackathon problem statements, set up hands-on lab environments, and build sample applications on AWS services to demonstrate real-world use cases.
•	Coordinate across product marketing, field marketing, tech teams, PR, and business teams to ensure programs ladder up to broader GTM goals.
•	Build and maintain engagement with 3P developer communities — open-source organizations, tech media with community reach, and influencer-led developer groups.
•	Savvy in producing developer-facing content across formats: technical blogs, vlogs, demo videos, and social posts.
•	Bring creative, out-of-the-box thinking to program design — crafting experiences that stand out to developers and builders who have seen it all.
•	Mentor and develop a small team of marketers, raising the bar on both technical depth and creative execution across the squad.
Amazon-10596130.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- A strong portfolio of self-produced content — blogs, videos, vlogs, or social posts — that demonstrates the ability to engage a technical audience. Personal influencer or creator experience is a strong plus.
- Creative instinct: able to come up with ideas that grab developer attention in a crowded feed — unexpected formats, compelling hooks, culturally relevant angles.
- Comfortable working cross-functionally with marketing, tech, and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication in both Chinese and English.
- Experience with cloud computing technologies, especially AI/ML services.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
- Experience as a content creator, tech influencer, or community leader with a demonstrable online presence.
- Proficiency with video editing tools, social media analytics, and content management workflows.

We are looking for a driven and analytical Senior Financial Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment to support Imports — the end-to-end inbound freight that moves Amazon's import volume from China to European fulfilment centres by both ocean and air.
EU Imports spans the full freight journey — origin handling in China, port-to-port, and destination delivery — across an end-to-end annual cost base of approximately $380M. The role turns carrier cost, invoice, rate-card and volume data into the rates and cost models that drive the monthly close and forward guidance, and is central to understanding and improving the economics of the business. The current emphasis is on ocean and destination economics, alongside origin cost work in China.
The role will require learning quickly to understand the big picture of how Global Logistics fits into Amazon's overall supply chain, gaining proficiency in our data to capture the right details, and communicating clearly to effectively partner with business leaders and influence decisions. It requires high judgement and the ability to drive both strategic and tactical goals.
This role partners closely with a broad range of finance and business leaders — Operations executional teams, Procurement, Controllership, long-term planning teams, and FP&A. A typical day provides the opportunity to own high-impact projects that drive cost out of the business, build accurate and insightful reporting, and develop influential frameworks that drive key decision-making for an evolving business. You'll track performance metrics, analyse data and build financial models to identify where we can drive better efficiency and productivity, and show how different scenarios impact our business financially — vital for stakeholders making decisions.
This role will support the EU Financial Automation launch between 2026 and 2027, performing tech system reconciliation and financial validation across upstream data sources (XBTMS, Virtual Manifest), the Griffin manifest platform, and downstream Finance reporting (TFS / USL). The Sr. Financial Analyst  will partner with the Product team on new GL program and new carrier onboarding to financial automation, ensuring finance requirements are built into the launch bar from Day 1. The role will be the Finance owner for EU-region FA launch readiness — defining the financial reporting bar, leading exception triage on data accuracy / completeness / timeliness, and driving cross-functional decisions with GLS Finance, Controllership, IVT, Hydra, and Product partners. As the program scales, the role will own the EU manifest data pipeline and the metrics mechanism that gives Finance visibility into automation health at the transactional level — enabling Finance to move from manual processing to systematic controllership.
Key job responsibilities
•	Own the monthly executive close (MEC) for EU Imports freight — actuals, accruals, variance versus guidance, and clear commentary for leadership.
•	Build and maintain the freight cost & rate engine — charge-code-level rates (cost per container, cost per chargeable kg) used to manifest monthly cost and feed guidance.
•	Drive the planning and guidance cycles (OP1, OP2, Q2G, Q3G, 3YF) — cost models, bridge walks (actual vs plan vs prior guidance), and scenario analysis.
•	Analyse and improve ocean and destination cost economics, while supporting origin (China) and port-to-port cost work across the end-to-end journey.
•	Reconcile actual carrier cost and invoices against rate cards; partner with Procurement on rate guidance and validation.
•	Lead cost-out initiatives — sizing, scoring, and tracking savings.
•	Use advanced MS Excel and SQL to work with large data sets; deliver plans, forecasts, budgets and consolidations; improve, scale, and automate finance tools across teams.
•	Build effective business partnerships across Operations, Controllership, Procurement and FP&A manage competing priorities and communicate complex finance issues clearly to varied audiences.
•	Proactively identify and resolve defects; seek and leverage diverse perspectives; contribute to a positive, collaborative team.
•	Financial cost manifest pipeline development experience — designed or operated a multi-system cost data pipeline and built a metrics tracking mechanism for financial automation programs; established data visibility across various source systems for cost-element traceability and performed deep analysis at the transactional level to surface drivers of variance.
Amazon-10478834.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 4+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- Experience as a lean sensei, or experience working as a Quality Assurance Engineer

Preferred qualifications
- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

Amazon-10490710.title: Senior Manager, Brand Protection, China, Perfect Order Experience
Amazon-10490710.description:
Amazon's Perfect Order Experience (POE) team works to ensure that buyers receive authentic products in the condition they are expecting. We design and implement policies, tools and technology innovations to protect the buying experience on Amazon while minimizing friction for sellers. Candidates will be responsible for a wide range of duties related to the identification, investigation and elimination of online risk while balancing for seller experience.
This role leads the Brand Protection (BP) team in China, from setting the vision to executing upon it, responsible for protecting intellectual property, reducing counterfeit defects, and improving the seller experience for China-based brands and third-party sellers across Amazon's worldwide marketplaces. The ideal self-driven candidate possesses superior business judgment, analytical thinking, and has a long history leading high performing teams.
About the team
Selling Partner Support (SPS) is responsible for creating a trustworthy shopping experience across Amazon stores worldwide by protecting customers, brands, selling partners and Amazon from fraud, counterfeit, and abuse as well as empowering, providing world‐class support, and building loyalty with Amazon’s millions of selling partners. We value individual expression, encourage debate and critical thinking, and invite you to bring your true self to work every day. Only by embracing inclusivity can we deliver for our customers. Our unique backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our ability to achieve Amazon's mission of being Earth's most customer-centric company.
Amazon-10490710.requirements:

- Experience in risk management, audit, legal, compliance or a related field including engaging with external stakeholders
- Experience in team management with 5 or more direct reports
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with audit or risk program design, control environment process documentation, and control mapping
- Master's degree or equivalent

Amazon-10576519.title: Senior Manager, Solution Architects, Partner Solutions
Amazon-10576519.description:
Lead the APAC Partner Solutions team within Amazon Ads, responsible for helping partners design, build and scale advertising technology solutions. This role will manage solution architects and technical account managers working with diverse partners including Enterprise Resource Planning software systems (ERPs), ISVs, and agencies. The position requires strong technical leadership, business acumen, and the ability to influence both partner and internal stakeholders to drive adoption of Amazon Ads solutions.
Key job responsibilities
Strategic Leadership:
- Lead global team of solution architects supporting advertising technology partners
- Develop and execute technical strategy aligned with organizational goals
- Drive innovation and adoption of new advertising capabilities
- Create frameworks for solution design and delivery at scale
- Build and manage relationships with senior partner leadership
- Influence product strategy and roadmap development
Team Management:
- Hire, develop, and retain high-performing solution architects
- Manage performance and career development
- Create learning and development programs
- Drive operational excellence and best practices
- Ensure team delivery quality and consistency
- Balance resources across partner initiatives
Technical Excellence:
- Guide complex solution architectures and implementations
- Review and approve technical proposals
- Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, and scalability requirements
- Drive adoption of AI/ML capabilities and emerging technologies
- Create scalable architectural patterns
Cross-organizational Impact:
- Collaborate with product, engineering, and business leadership
- Drive alignment across partner development initiatives
Manage stakeholder relationships and expectations
- Represent team in strategic planning
- Lead technical thought leadership initiatives
- Influence industry direction and standards
A day in the life
Your day begins leading team meetings to review complex technical solutions and partner implementations. You meet with partner executives to understand strategic priorities and align Amazon Ads' capabilities with their goals. You coach your solution architects on complex designs, review technical proposals, and provide guidance on implementing new advertising features. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product teams to influence roadmaps based on partner needs, drive operational excellence initiatives, and ensure your team is effectively helping partners leverage Amazon's full suite of advertising technologies. You focus on developing your team while managing stakeholder relationships across the organization.
About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.
Amazon-10576519.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 5+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

Preferred qualifications
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
- 9+ years of managing a technical team of solution architects, sales engineers or similar technical roles experience
- 10+ years of advising and influencing executive leadership experience
- Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
- MBA, or 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Master's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology, or Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field

Amazon-10596658.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Educational Bootcamp Program, Amazon Ads
Amazon-10596658.description:
Amazon Ads is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to own the offline execution engine behind Amazon Ads China's advertiser education program. This role is the single-threaded owner for planning, running and scaling our Full Funnel Bootcamp series — our scaled, open-to-all education flagship for CN cross-border advertisers — plus a growing portfolio of co-hosted bootcamps with Amazon Global Selling (AGS) and third-party vertical media partners.
Key job responsibilities
Strategy & roadmap
- Own the strategy and annual roadmap for the Amazon Full Funnel Bootcamp series and the full co-hosted bootcamp portfolio with AGS and 3P vertical media.
- Define target advertiser segments, bootcamp learning objectives, and success metrics tied to downstream business outcomes — not attendance alone.
- Prioritize across formats (flagship bootcamp · city tour · 3P co-hosted) and locations.
Content programming
- Build tiered curriculum, from fundamentals to hands-on practice, that turns product complexity into a clear first-step path for advertisers.
- Own speaker management, and maintain a consistent speaker quality bar across bootcamps.
Operation & scale
- Own end-to-end operations: venue, vendor, agenda, speakers, registration, logistics, on-site execution, post-event follow-up.
- Manage bootcamp vendors and trainers; own SOPs, budget, compliance review and legal/PR approvals.
Cross-team alignment & measurement
- Serve as the single-threaded facilitator across content, channel delivery, product marketing, PR/legal, and finance.
- Drive alignment specifically with AGS and 3P vertical media partners on co-hosted bootcamps — shared goals, joint agenda, co-marketing plan.
- Own bootcamp measurement end-to-end. Build and run the post-bootcamp measurement loop. Communicate results, insights and asks to leadership through written monthly recaps and quarterly program reviews.
About the team
Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful business results. With hundreds of millions of active customer accounts worldwide and first-party shopping, streaming, and browsing signals, we help brands craft strategies that resonate with consumers. Our solutions span Sponsored Ads, Display, Video, and Audio across Amazon's surfaces — Amazon.com, Prime Video, Twitch, IMDb, Alexa, and Fire TV — plus thousands of third-party apps, sites, and streaming services.
In China, we support cross-border advertisers growing globally. We invest in local-language education, channels, and partnerships at every stage — from first campaign to full-funnel brand builder.
Amazon-10596658.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 7+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 4+ years directly owning offline event/bootcamp planning and execution at scale.
- Demonstrated experience owning a multi-event, multi-city annual event portfolio (10+ offline events/year, 500+ attendees per flagship session) end-to-end: strategy, agenda, vendors, speakers, logistics, on-site execution, measurement.
- willing to travel domestically ~50% for offline bootcamps.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience in a business-to-business (B2B) environment, high-tech products/services
- MBA
- Track record of tying offline event/bootcamp outcomes to downstream business metrics (product adoption, advertiser readiness, revenue influence) — not just attendance or satisfaction scores.

Amazon-10577128.description:

Amazon-10501754.title: Senior Product Manager, Global Seller Supply Chain - PMO
Amazon-10501754.description:
Amazon Global Selling has been helping individuals and businesses increase sales and reach new customers around the globe. The Global Selling team in China is responsible for recruiting local businesses to sell on Amazon’s 21 overseas marketplaces, and supporting local Sellers’ success and growth on the Amazon. Our vision is to be the first choice for all types of Chinese business to go globally.
Amazon Global Selling is seeking a dynamic, highly motivated product manager to join the Global Seller Supply Chain central PMO team, focusing on developing and executing inbound logistics product solutions for Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) — Amazon's end-to-end fulfillment service that stores, picks, packs, and ships products on behalf of sellers. In this highly visible role, you will work closely with global product and marketplace teams to build logistics solutions that improve business outcomes and seller experience, while driving high-impact programs that continuously enhance sellers' growth and profitability.
This role offers a unique opportunity to innovate with data-driven insights, influence cross-functional and global partners, and shape decisions at the senior leadership level in an exciting and fast-paced business. The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, intellectually curious with a passion for continuous learning and exploring new possibilities, has a track record of delivering results and partnering cross-functionally, excels at performing deep-dive analyses to uncover seller behavior patterns, identifies key pain points and needs from the seller perspective, and possesses best-in-class oral and written communication skills.
Key job responsibilities
- Research and dive deep into assigned seller experience segments to become the domain expert, define the ideal seller experience, and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Based on research insights, develop new products, features, or programmatic services that improve seller experience and accelerate business growth; define go-to-market strategies and drive successful product launches and adoption.
- Clearly define and communicate product requirements, secure alignment and support from internal stakeholders and external partners.
- Establish strong relationships and build trust with local and global stakeholders to advance product and feature proposals from concept to execution.
- Lead key planning cycles and reporting cadences for your assigned domain, including regular readouts up to VP level and contributions to SVP-level business reviews.
About the team
We are Amazon Global Selling (AGS) PMO team. We collaborate with AGS business teams to identify key Seller needs and partner with global product teams to develop tools and solutions to improve Seller experience and sustainable growth.

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Amazon-10601957.title: Senior Seller Consultant , CN2MENA
Amazon-10601957.description:
Amazon is looking for a smart and ambitious Seller Consultant to join its China team. The objective of the Sales consultant is to deliver new business growth and maximize revenue generation across Amazon's suite of products for merchants. Recruiting and launching sellers on Amazon's global marketplaces. You will analyze traffic and sales data to identify opportunities to help sellers succeed on the marketplaces.
Your superior communication, organizational and technical skills will enable you to operate in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, where you will have the autonomy to take full control and responsibility for achieving our business objectives.
Specific Responsibilities include:
Develop a category recruitment strategy by analyzing the competitive landscape and defining new products' value proposition.
Identify, recruit and support sellers of various types (SMEs to large retailers) to execute on aggressive growth plans.
Review and monitor performance and sales of Amazon's partners in order to provide them with consulting advice to grow their business.
Feed back to other teams within Amazon worldwide lessons learned during project implementation and post-live support phases.
Coordinate and lead project with cross function teams and deliver result with stakeholders
Key job responsibilities
1. Seller Acquisition & Recruitment
Develop and execute strategies to identify, attract, and onboard high-quality CN sellers to the Amazon marketplaces in the MENA region (amazon.ae and amazon.sa).
Build a robust pipeline of prospective sellers through outreach, networking, and partnership initiatives.
2. Seller Launch & Onboarding Support ("Cold Start")
Provide dedicated, hands-on support to new sellers during their critical launch phase to ensure a successful "cold start" on the platform.
Guide sellers through account setup, catalog creation, and the implementation of best practices for listing, pricing, and fulfillment.
3. Seller Growth & Performance Management
Proactively identify and remove blockers (logistical, operational, knowledge-based) that hinder seller growth and performance.
Analyze seller metrics and data to provide tailored advice and interventions that accelerate sales velocity and account health on amazon.ae and amazon.sa.
Empower sellers to scale their businesses by educating them on MENA-specific customer preferences, promotional tools, and inventory management.
4. Relationship & Account Management
Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with a portfolio of Chinese sellers.
Act as the primary point of contact and advocate for sellers, ensuring a positive experience with Amazon MENA platforms.

Amazon-10600730.title: Senior Seller Consultant, JP New Seller Recruitment Team, Amazon JP Targeted Recruitment
Amazon-10600730.description:
Amazon Global Selling is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Seller Consultant to join the Japan Targeted Recruitment (TR) team based in Hangzhou. The TR team takes a proactive, research-driven approach to identify, engage, and onboard high-quality Chinese sellers with strong product-market fit for the Japanese marketplace — one of Amazon's fastest-growing cross-border destinations.
As a Senior Seller Consultant, you will independently own a portfolio of high-value seller relationships and drive measurable business outcomes across the full seller lifecycle — from strategic prospecting and consultative engagement to launch execution and post-launch growth acceleration. You will be expected to develop deep expertise in JP market dynamics, leverage data and industry intelligence to build differentiated recruitment strategies, and influence cross-functional teams to remove systemic barriers for seller success.
This role requires strong business judgment, the ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations, and a track record of delivering results through others. You will serve as a subject matter expert on JP seller recruitment within the team, contribute to playbook development, and help raise the bar on recruitment quality and seller productivity.
Key job responsibilities
Develop deep category expertise through industry research (supply chain, manufacturing clusters, pricing, seasonal trends), and execute category-level recruitment strategies based on JP marketplace gaps and demand signals
Proactively build a high-quality seller pipeline through industry cluster mapping, trade shows, factory visits, and cross-marketplace analysis; develop segment-specific pitch content for different seller types
Own end-to-end seller onboarding experience and drive seller success
Provide data-driven post-launch consulting to drive seller tiering-up, deliver customized selection guidance, and drive cross-launch from NA/EU into JP
Identify gaps and build new initiatives from 0 to 1 (e.g., cluster engagement program); own cross-functional project management with clear milestones, stakeholder coordination, and scalable SOPs
Partner with cross teams on GTM plans and seller logistics optimization; represent Amazon at industry events

Amazon-10585952.title: Senior Sourcing Manager, HPB, DOCE Global Sourcing, Hardlines Private Brand
Amazon-10585952.description:
Would you like to be part of an organization developing the next generation of leaders in a rapidly growing, highly innovative global business? Are you passionate about driving continuous improvement and cost optimization? Are you curious about Amazon's business expansion in international markets? Do you thrive working with diverse, cross-functional teams across multiple countries?
If yes, Amazon Global Sourcing is the right fit for you.
For those passionate about Amazon's Private Brands business, the Sourcing Manager role offers an exciting opportunity to dive deep into data, collaborate with global suppliers, identify process improvement opportunities, and design scalable, long-term solutions. Working alongside product development, quality assurance, operations, transportation, and customer service teams, you'll execute and continuously improve best practices in Global Sourcing.
This role touches nearly every aspect of Amazon's worldwide operations—including retail, legal, product compliance, transportation, tax, treasury, accounting, graphic design, customer service, and public relations. You'll manage the end-to-end global sourcing process: product planning, vendor/item setup and maintenance, pricing, packaging, assortment planning, and vendor relationship management.
The ideal candidate thrives in a demanding yet collegial, team-oriented environment. Domestic and international travel may be required.
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute category vendor management and sourcing strategies in alignment with business objectives
- Drive continuous cost optimization through strategic negotiations and supply chain efficiency initiatives
- Conduct comprehensive supplier evaluation, selection, and performance management
- Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver best-in-class product development
- Identify process defects and develop scalable solutions to accelerate Private Label business growth
- Collaborate with teams to enhance business management tools and improve vendor productivity
- Manage vendor relationships across multiple product categories and geographies
About the team
About the team
Amazon Private Brand Global Sourcing team partners with suppliers capable of producing and shipping high-quality products globally, with a focus on driving profitable and sustainable business growth.

Amazon-10509799.title: Senior Strategic Account Manager
Amazon-10509799.description:
Are you passionate about partnering with top-tier strategic sellers to drive unprecedented growth? Join our team where you'll work directly with China's leading merchants to co-create innovative initiatives that reshape how they grow on Amazon. This role goes beyond traditional account management—you'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor, diving deep into complex seller business models and collaborating with global teams to deliver tailored solutions that unlock new opportunities.
You'll thrive in this position if you're energized by strategic thinking, open-minded collaboration, and continuous learning. The sellers you manage operate at significant scale and complexity, requiring you to navigate cross-functional partnerships and influence teams worldwide to solve sophisticated challenges and drive meaningful business impact.
Key job responsibilities
- Partner with high-complexity strategic sellers to understand their business strategies, identify growth opportunities, and co-create innovative initiatives that drive measurable results
- Analyze seller performance data and market trends to develop actionable insights and recommendations that align with seller objectives and Amazon's product portfolio
- Collaborate with global cross-functional teams to address seller pain points, influence product and process improvements, and deliver solutions that enhance seller experience and business outcomes
- Engage sellers through strategic consultations to educate them on Amazon products and services, ensuring they leverage the right tools to accelerate growth and optimize their operations
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with seller leadership by demonstrating deep understanding of their business model, anticipating their needs, and delivering proactive support
A day in the life
Your day centers on high-impact seller engagement. You might start by analyzing performance dashboards to spot growth opportunities for your portfolio, then jump into strategic conversations with seller executives to explore new initiatives. You'll navigate between seller-facing consultations and internal collaborations, working with global product, operations, and support teams to influence solutions for complex challenges. Throughout, you're balancing tactical problem-solving with long-term strategic planning, ensuring every interaction moves the needle on seller growth while continuously learning about emerging business models and market dynamics.
About the team
The Strategic Seller Management team partners with China's most sophisticated and high-growth merchants, helping them scale their businesses on Amazon's global platform. Our mission is to unlock transformative growth by deeply understanding seller strategies and delivering tailored solutions that address their unique challenges.
We foster a culture of collaboration and innovation, working seamlessly with global teams to shape the seller experience. As Amazon continues expanding opportunities for sellers worldwide, our team plays a critical role in building lasting partnerships that drive mutual success. You'll join a group of curious, strategic thinkers who are passionate about solving complex problems and creating impact at scale.

Amazon-10576625.title: Software Development Manager, Traffic Marketing Tech - Search
Amazon-10576625.description:
Amazon's Stores Economics and Science organization is building the Internet's largest-scale Search Marketing systems worldwide. The team is responsible for a number of business-critical systems that generate, target, measure, and optimize hundreds of millions of search engine ad placements and organic search listings. We bring prospective customers who start their shopping journeys on search engines, and increasingly in AI assistants and agentic shopping experiences, to Amazon through our ML- and LLM-driven software and systems. We apply best-in-class digital marketing and search engine optimization (SEO) techniques to process and optimize billions of webpages, images, videos, and content snippets to improve Amazon's discoverability across both traditional search and AI-mediated discovery. We routinely solve challenges related to large-scale distributed services, applied science, big data systems, and web search. Cutting-edge technology is core to our business, from large language models, generative AI, and agentic systems to machine learning and large-scale optimization, and we build in an AI-native way, using AI tools and agents across the development lifecycle to raise our quality and velocity.
As a Software Development Manager on this team, you will lead a team of software development engineers building the technology behind tens of millions of daily search-engine shopping queries. You will own the technical direction and product roadmap for your area, partnering closely with product managers to define requirements and with peer engineering teams to unblock dependencies. With a strong research-and-development component to the work and multi-million dollar business impact, this role combines hands-on technical leadership with meaningful people management and career development.
Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a team of software development engineers, providing coaching, career development planning, and actionable feedback that raises the performance bar.
- Define and prioritize the team's product roadmap in partnership with product managers, translating customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and sprint plans.
- Own the operational health and quality of your team's services, establishing metrics and mechanisms that ensure reliability at scale.
- Collaborate across dependent teams to resolve blockers, align on priorities, and deliver cohesive solutions that serve shared business goals.
- Drive system design decisions and evaluate tradeoffs across scalability, maintainability, and performance, keeping your architecture simple and sustainable.
A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing operational dashboards and triaging any alerts before joining your team's standup. From there, you might spend time in a design review with your engineers, then shift to a roadmap planning session with your product manager to scope upcoming features. Afternoons often involve cross-team syncs to resolve dependencies and unblock your engineers, followed by a one-on-one where you discuss a team member's career goals. Throughout the day, you balance technical depth with people leadership, using AI-native tools and workflows that keep the team productive and learning.
About the team
The Search Marketing team within Stores Economics and Science builds the systems that connect shoppers on external search engines and AI assistants with the right products on Amazon. We operate at massive scale, processing billions of webpages and content assets through machine learning and optimization pipelines. Our work has a direct, measurable impact on how customers begin their shopping journeys.
We are an inclusive, collaborative group of engineers, scientists, and product managers who value curiosity and continuous improvement. Cross-team partnerships are central to how we operate, giving you broad influence and exposure to new technologies — including AI-native development workflows that keep the team at the forefront of modern software engineering.
Amazon-10576625.requirements:

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in development of distributed/scalable systems and high-volume transaction applications
- Experience driving adoption of AI-native engineering workflows and ability to think critically about where AI tools and agents can meaningfully improve developer productivity, software quality, and operational efficiency.

Amazon-10589621.title: Solution Architect - Manufacturing SA, Manufacturing  SA
Amazon-10589621.description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
As a Solutions Architect within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts. This position will support important manufacturing industry customers in China.
Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform.
The ideal candidate will posses customer facing skills that will allow them to represent Amazon well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
Key job responsibilities
· Serve as a key technical member of the Business Development team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform.
· Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
· Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by AWS partners)
· Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
· Understand the AWS market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.
A day in the life
· Serve as a key technical member of the Business Development team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform.
· Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
· Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by AWS partners)
· Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
· Understand the AWS market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.
About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Amazon-10601801.title: Solutions Architect I, Amazon Selling Partner API, Selling Partner Dev Servi-VAR
Amazon-10601801.description:
Amazon is looking for a motivated and technically skilled Solutions Architect to work with customers, generating attention and support for Amazon Selling Partner API.
As a customer advisor, the Solutions Architect will help organizations understand the opportunities to develop and integrate with Selling Partner APIs. You will have the opportunity to help drive adoption of SP-API within organizations ranging from new start-ups to mid-sized customers. You should be comfortable building technical credibility with API Developers, Solution Architects, and Product Managers.
The ability to link technology with measurable business value is important to a solutions architect role. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think about business, products, and technical challenges.
Key job responsibilities
- Support customers in building secure applications, software and services on the Selling Partner API
- Help ensure Selling Partner API solutions comply with acceptable use policies, security standards, and best practices
- Contribute to technical products that support secure API development such as code samples and documentation
- Provide technical support and guidance for security controls to API developers
- Write code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for our developer community
- Work with customers to understand how they are using our API services, and provide feedback to development teams
- Act as a technical liaison between customer, support & engineering, and business teams
- Support the localization and adoption of SP-API AI solutions for the China marketplace, including adapting MCP tools, developer documentation, code samples, and AI-assisted integration workflows to meet the unique technical requirements, regulatory environment, and developer ecosystem of Chinese Selling Partners and solution providers
A day in the life
The Solutions Architect team supporting the Selling Partner API (SP-API) is responsible for helping external developers, ISVs, and partners successfully build API applications. In a typical week, you will engage with customers—guiding them through API best practices, authentication workflows, and integration patterns across Orders, Catalog, Fulfillment, and Notifications APIs. You will help partners understand how to automate inventory management, streamline order processing, and build selling experiences. Working with internal Amazon teams and leveraging knowledge of SP-API capabilities, you'll help craft reliable, compliant solutions that address our partners' business challenges. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
About the team
Our global Solutions Architecture team enables technology Solution Providers to build on Selling Partner API. Selling Partner API is an integrated web service API that helps Amazon Selling Partners programmatically exchange data on listings, orders, payments, reports, and more.

- Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
- Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)
- 2+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 1+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.
Associate Solutions Architect
As an Associate Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers successfully implement AI and cloud technologies. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient AI and cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
Building relationships to understand our customers is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
You’ll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just want to be part of an industry movement; you’ll want to be leading it. As a builder, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
这里是亚马逊云科技(AWS)解决方案架构师团队，如果你想指引并帮助客户使用最先进的AI和云服务, 如果你愿意以技术引领行业的发展，如果你喜欢充满激情的工作，我们期待你的加入! 作为亚马逊云科技的解决方案架构师，你将是备受客户信任的技术向导，通过技术为客户创造长远的价值。你将与公司遍布全球的产品、开发、技术支持、客户经理等团队通力合作, 用广泛的云服务为客户提供最佳方案, 用先进的云理念解决客户的难题。
这里有最丰富的技术方向供你选择，你可以深入研究Agents, AI, 容器, 微服务, DevOps, 也可以发展数据分析专家, 尝试各种数据库以及数据分析方案; 你可以利用AWS Bedrock/Kiro来为客户展示最先进的AIDLC理念，也可以利用AWS的工具搭建一款Serverless的手机应用, 也可以制作一部你自己的游戏; 你可以专注物联网，边缘计算的方案设计和应用实现，也可以训练一台自己的无人驾驶小车。

* 响应客户云服务技术咨询，执行云计算方案原型开发。
* 为用户制定合理的上云方案, 帮助用户开启云之旅。
* 拓展用户对云产品的理解, 促进IT架构优化和技术转型。
* 与云产品和研发部门深度合作, 根据客户的需求不断改进亚马逊云产品。
* 通过客户workshop, 大型公开活动等方式传递云上最佳技术实践。

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Associate Solutions Architect
As an Associate Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers successfully implement AI and cloud technologies. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient AI and cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
Building relationships to understand our customers is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. Amazon-10482359.title: Sourcing Manager
Amazon-10482359.description:
Would you like to be part of an organization developing the next generation of leaders in a rapidly growing, highly innovative global business? Are you passionate about driving continuous improvement and cost optimization? Are you curious about Amazon's business expansion in international markets? Do you thrive working with diverse, cross-functional teams across multiple countries?
If yes, Amazon Global Sourcing is the right fit for you.
For those passionate about Amazon's Private Brands business, the Sourcing Manager role offers an exciting opportunity to dive deep into data, collaborate with global suppliers, identify process improvement opportunities, and design scalable, long-term solutions. Working alongside product development, quality assurance, operations, transportation, and customer service teams, you'll execute and continuously improve best practices in Global Sourcing.
This role touches nearly every aspect of Amazon's worldwide operations—including retail, legal, product compliance, transportation, tax, treasury, accounting, graphic design, customer service, and public relations. You'll manage the end-to-end global sourcing process: product planning, vendor/item setup and maintenance, pricing, packaging, assortment planning, and vendor relationship management.
The ideal candidate thrives in a demanding yet collegial, team-oriented environment. Domestic and international travel may be required.
Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute category vendor management and sourcing strategies in alignment with business objectives
- Drive continuous cost optimization through strategic negotiations and supply chain efficiency initiatives
- Conduct comprehensive supplier evaluation, selection, and performance management
- Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver best-in-class product development
- Identify process defects and develop scalable solutions to accelerate Private Label business growth
- Collaborate with teams to enhance business management tools and improve vendor productivity
- Manage vendor relationships across multiple product categories and geographies
Amazon-10482359.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
- Excellent English written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of SQL and VBA at an advanced level
- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization

Amazon-10521269.title: Sr Manager, GPM , Large Client Sales, Ads
Amazon-10521269.description:
Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital display and search advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high-quality sites across the web, and on millions of Kindles, tablets, and mobile devices.
Amazon Advertising is seeking a ‘builder’ who will be responsible for developing and executing a bold and innovative vision that delights our advertisers and partners by maximizing the return on their marketing investment and helping them grow their businesses. The organization covers all Amazon Ads products, such as Sponsored Ads, Video and STV, Display, Device Advertising and more. Internally, this role will partner closely across a number of teams, including Amazon Consumer, AWS, Twitch, Product, Creative, Ad Tech, and more. Externally, this individual will represent Amazon and lead joint business plan negotiations with large advertisers and partners, and be an active participant at trade events. You will have deep connections across the industry at the C-Suite and across the advertising agency landscape.
An extensive career as an executive in the advertising Industry will make a successful transition as a Head of Large Client Development. You will be comfortable with ambiguity and will lead and innovate towards the future, defining the vision for the business and investment areas. Will lead the organization to be strategic advisors, providing customer insights that drive measurable business outcomes and growth with clients. You will leverage experience and high-judgment to define organizational strategy, organizational design, processes, tools, and incentives to maximize ROI and accelerate growth. This individual will invent on behalf of customers, drive execution of strategy, ensuring that the organization is consistently delivering measurable results in advertiser satisfaction, YoY revenue growth, renewal rates and other operational quality metrics. This individual will partner closely with Amazon leadership to establish joint goals and strategies.
If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team that’s building a unique, innovative business with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
1) Build a high performance, input driven team
• Attract, hire and retain top commercial and digital media talent
• Provide strong mentoring and coaching to direct reports and commercial representatives
• Elevate skillsets and develop bench strength in the organization
• Determine short and long-range revenue plans per property, vertical, account, territory, and AE; annual revenue budgets; tactical action plans
• Create and implement programs and tools that increase performance by the commercial staff
• Develop relationships with key digital media and marketing executives in CN.
• Lead the CN team to promote advertising solution for advertisers and customers.
2) Grow revenue
• Develop account, and agency coverage strategy for China’s global brands and export industry
• Drive strategic relationships with Fortune 500 type clients. Build upon prior success in this area to continue to grow this opportunity.
• Drive the commercial management process as well as play a hands-on role in generating leads and opening doors for the commercial organization.
• Partner with Amazon Retail and Online Ad Product teams on category and product development strategies
• Lead the larger organization of Amazon Advertising for success
• Partner brands and support all advertiser education initiatives that will help their advertising on Amazon.
3) Serve as Amazon’s Advertising Industry Ambassador
• Responsible for overseeing decision making and strategies for large customers within the Endemic business lines.
• Utilize existing client and agency relationships to drive large, long-term deals with top brand advertisers
• Represent Amazon at key industry conferences, trade magazines and other speaking events
• Drive strategic meetings with senior executives to help set program direction and priorities
4) Drive product innovation through thorough understanding and representation of customer and industry trends/needs to ensure Amazon continues to provide a powerful and differentiated value proposition
• Partner with product development to prioritize and build innovative new advertising products to provide a truly better and differentiated advertising business for our customers
• Assess potential acquisition or partner targets to expand the program’s reach and scope
Amazon-10521269.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 15+years of experience selling advertising or advertising-like services.
- Bachelor's degree.
- Proven track record of managing internal and external relationships and building high performance teams, hiring and developing the best talent.
- Proven records of delivering commercial results from B2B companies that delivers complex enterprise-level solutions.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills externally and internally, strong attention to detail, and good follow-through.
- Have exceptional management experience in developing and executing commercial strategies, tactics, plans, processes, systems and programs to represent customer needs/perspectives.
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in SQL Server/MySQL

Preferred qualifications
- Ability to work cross-functionally and with a wide range of employees with different skill sets and backgrounds.
- Exhibits excellent judgment.
- Hires great people, develop and care about them.
- Has relentlessly high standards.
- Thinks strategically, but stays on top of tactical execution.

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital display and search advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high-quality sites across the web, and on millions of Kindles, tablets, and mobile devices.
Amazon Advertising is seeking a ‘builder’ who will be responsible for developing and executing a bold and innovative vision that delights our advertisers and partners by maximizing the return on their marketing investment and helping them grow their businesses. The organization covers all Amazon Ads products, such as Sponsored Ads, Video and STV, Display, Device Advertising and more. Internally, this role will partner closely across a number of teams, including Amazon Consumer, AWS, Twitch, Product, Creative, Ad Tech, and more. Externally, this individual will represent Amazon and lead joint business plan negotiations with large advertisers and partners, and be an active participant at trade events. You will have deep connections across the industry at the C-Suite and across the advertising agency landscape.
An extensive career as an executive in the advertising Industry will make a successful transition as a Head of Large Client Development. You will be comfortable with ambiguity and will lead and innovate towards the future, defining the vision for the business and investment areas. Will lead the organization to be strategic advisors, providing customer insights that drive measurable business outcomes and growth with clients. You will leverage experience and high-judgment to define organizational strategy, organizational design, processes, tools, and incentives to maximize ROI and accelerate growth. This individual will invent on behalf of customers, drive execution of strategy, ensuring that the organization is consistently delivering measurable results in advertiser satisfaction, YoY revenue growth, renewal rates and other operational quality metrics. This individual will partner closely with Amazon leadership to establish joint goals and strategies.
If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team that’s building a unique, innovative business with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
1) Build a high performance, input driven team
• Attract, hire and retain top commercial and digital media talent
• Provide strong mentoring and coaching to direct reports and commercial representatives
• Elevate skillsets and develop bench strength in the organization
• Determine short and long-range revenue plans per property, vertical, account, territory, and AE; annual revenue budgets; tactical action plans
• Create and implement programs and tools that increase performance by the commercial staff
• Develop relationships with key digital media and marketing executives in CN.
• Lead the CN team to promote advertising solution for advertisers and customers.
2) Grow revenue
• Develop account, and agency coverage strategy for China’s global brands and export industry
• Drive strategic relationships with Fortune 500 type clients. Build upon prior success in this area to continue to grow this opportunity.
• Drive the commercial management process as well as play a hands-on role in generating leads and opening doors for the commercial organization.
• Partner with Amazon Retail and Online Ad Product teams on category and product development strategies
• Lead the larger organization of Amazon Advertising for success
• Partner brands and support all advertiser education initiatives that will help their advertising on Amazon.
3) Serve as Amazon’s Advertising Industry Ambassador
• Responsible for overseeing decision making and strategies for large customers within the Endemic business lines.
• Utilize existing client and agency relationships to drive large, long-term deals with top brand advertisers
• Represent Amazon at key industry conferences, trade magazines and other speaking events
• Drive strategic meetings with senior executives to help set program direction and priorities
4) Drive product innovation through thorough understanding and representation of customer and industry trends/needs to ensure Amazon continues to provide a powerful and differentiated value proposition
• Partner with product development to prioritize and build innovative new advertising products to provide a truly better and differentiated advertising business for our customers
• Assess potential acquisition or partner targets to expand the program’s reach and scope

Amazon-10465348.title: Sr Risk Manager, RISC (Program)
Amazon-10465348.description:
The Regulatory Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies.
In this role you will be working directly with Testing, Inspection, and Certification providers (TICs) to scale product compliance across multiple categories and policies. This will include visiting TICs, developing test plans for product testing, and engaging in business development to expand the TIC network. This role will also be engaged in improving selling partner experience by coordinating with business teams and addressing selling partner pain points.
The candidate must be comfortable balancing strategic thinking with tactical, detailed execution while working independently, sorting through ambiguously defined problems, identifying and facing big challenges, and adjusting to sudden and frequent change. Think of this role as a non-technical “solution architect” where you will be given the autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective mechanisms to scale policy compliance.
Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary liaison with TICs
• Develop and optimize test plans across multiple product categories
• Identify and onboard new TIC partners to expand network capabilities
• Drive strategic growth initiatives with existing TIC partners
• Create and maintain documentation for TIC processes and procedures
• Maintain regular communication channels with TIC partners for day-to-day operations
• Coordinate with internal business teams to streamline selling partner experience
• Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and selling partner challenges
• Develop and track key performance metrics
• Prepare and present progress reports to leadership
About the team
Here at Selling Partner Services, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 14 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 10,000+ employees in chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our DEI Ambassador Program. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
